noteEn: King Ping of Zhou moves east to Luoyi.

noteEn: "First ranked among the lords." Duke Xiang of Qin is first ranked among the lords (the Table puts it in 771 BCE).

noteEn: The Rong live in Guanzhong and along the Yi and the Luo.

noteEn: "Attacking Shen, he passed through Deng; the nephews of Deng said Chu could be taken, and the Marquis of Deng would not allow it." "He attacked Deng and destroyed it." Chu destroys Shen and Deng (Deng in 678 BCE by the Table).

note: 概覽（約略） 秦都雍
noteEn: Qin has its capital at Yong.

note: 「公好鶴，士不戰，滅我國」（史記·十二諸侯年表） 狄滅衛，衛遷楚丘（範圍約略）
noteEn: "The duke loved cranes, his men would not fight, and our state was destroyed." The Di destroy Wey, and Wey moves to Chuqiu.

note: 「滅虞、虢」（史記·十二諸侯年表） 晉滅虢（範圍約略）
noteEn: "Destroyed Yu and Guo." Jin destroys Guo.

note: 概覽（約略） 晉文公得南陽之地
noteEn: Duke Wen of Jin gains the land of Nanyang.

note: 秦穆公「益國十二，開地千里，遂霸西戎」（史記·秦本紀）
noteEn: Duke Mu of Qin "added twelve states, opened a thousand li of land, and so was overlord of the Western Rong".

note: 概覽（約略） 晉滅赤狄潞氏
noteEn: Jin destroys the Lu clan of the Red Di.

note: 概覽（約略） 齊滅萊
noteEn: Qi destroys Lai.

note: 概覽（約略） 晉敗狄於大鹵
noteEn: Jin defeats the Di at Dalu.

note: 概覽（約略） 鮮虞（白狄）
noteEn: The Xianyu, a people of the White Di.

note: 概覽（約略） 晉滅陸渾之戎
noteEn: Jin destroys the Rong of Luhun.

note: 概覽（約略） 吳滅徐，據淮南
noteEn: Wu destroys Xu and holds the land south of the Huai.

note: 吳王闔廬伐楚，入郢（史記·吳太伯世家）
noteEn: King Helü of Wu attacks Chu and enters Ying.

note: 「秦救至，吳去，昭王復入」（史記·十二諸侯年表） 秦救楚，吳師歸（範圍約略）
noteEn: "The relief from Qin arrived, Wu left, and King Zhao came back in." Qin relieves Chu, and the army of Wu goes home.

note: 「伐越」（史記·十二諸侯年表） 吳敗越於夫椒，越王棲會稽（範圍約略）
noteEn: "Attacked Yue." Wu defeats Yue at Fujiao, and the King of Yue takes refuge on Kuaiji.

note: 概覽（約略） 吳城邗，溝通江淮
noteEn: Wu walls Han and cuts a channel joining the Yangtze and the Huai.

note: 「楚滅陳，殺湣公」（史記·十二諸侯年表） 楚滅陳（《年表》在前479年；《左傳》在前478年）（範圍約略）
noteEn: "Chu destroyed Chen and killed Duke Min." Chu destroys Chen (479 BCE by the Table, 478 by the Zuozhuan).

note: 「越滅吳」（史記·六國年表） 越滅吳，北上琅邪（範圍約略）
noteEn: "Yue destroyed Wu." Yue destroys Wu and moves north to Langya.

note: 「元年未除服，登夏屋，誘代王，以金斗殺代王」（史記·六國年表） 趙襄子滅代（範圍約略）
noteEn: "In his first year, still in mourning, he climbed Mount Xiawu, lured the King of Dai, and killed him with a bronze ladle." Zhao Xiangzi destroys Dai.

note: 「襄子敗智伯晉陽，與魏、韓三分其地」（史記·六國年表）「遂殺智伯，盡滅智氏之族」（資治通鑑·卷1） 韓、趙、魏滅智氏，三分晉地（《通鑑》追敘於前403年）（範圍約略）
noteEn: "Xiangzi defeated Zhi Bo at Jinyang and with Wei and Han divided his land in three." "They killed Zhi Bo and wiped out the whole Zhi clan." Han, Zhao and Wei destroy the Zhi and divide the land of Jin in three (the Tongjian tells it under 403 BCE).

note: 「韓康子敗智伯于晉陽」（史記·六國年表）（範圍約略）
noteEn: "Han Kangzi defeated Zhi Bo at Jinyang."

note: 「魏桓子敗智伯于晉陽」（史記·六國年表）（範圍約略）
noteEn: "Wei Huanzi defeated Zhi Bo at Jinyang."

note: 「楚滅蔡」（史記·六國年表） 楚滅蔡（範圍約略）
noteEn: "Chu destroyed Cai." Chu destroys Cai.

note: 「滅杞」（史記·六國年表） 楚北取淮上（範圍約略）
noteEn: "Destroyed Qi" (the small state of that name, not the great one). Chu takes the land along the Huai to its north.

note: 「伐秦至鄭，還築洛陰、合陽」（史記·六國年表） 魏取秦河西（範圍約略）
noteEn: "Attacked Qin as far as Zheng, and on the way back walled Luoyin and Heyang." Wei takes Qin's land west of the Yellow River.

note: 概覽（約略） 楚南拓湘、贛
noteEn: Chu pushes south into the valleys of the Xiang and the Gan.

note: 「韓滅鄭，因徒都之」（資治通鑑·卷1） 韓滅鄭，徙都新鄭（範圍約略）
noteEn: "Han destroyed Zheng and moved its capital there." Han destroys Zheng and moves its capital to Xinzheng.

note: 概覽（約略） 魏徙都大梁
noteEn: Wei moves its capital to Daliang.

note: 「秦商鞅築冀闕宮庭於咸陽，徙都之」（資治通鑑·卷2） 商鞅變法，秦徙都咸陽（範圍約略）
noteEn: "Shang Yang of Qin built the Ji gate-towers and the palace courts at Xianyang, and the capital was moved there." The reforms of Shang Yang; Qin moves its capital to Xianyang.

note: 「越以此散，諸公族爭立，或爲王，或爲君，濱於海上，朝服於楚」（資治通鑑·卷2） 楚敗越（越亡之年諸說不一）（範圍約略）
noteEn: "With this Yue broke up; its princes fought for the succession, some as kings, some as lords, along the sea coast, and paid court to Chu." Chu defeats Yue (the year Yue ended is disputed).

note: 「魏入少梁、河西地於秦」（資治通鑑·卷2） 秦盡取魏河西（範圍約略）
noteEn: "Wei gave up Shaoliang and its land west of the River to Qin." Qin takes all of Wei's land west of the Yellow River.

note: 「魏因盡入上郡十五縣以謝焉」（資治通鑑·卷2） 魏獻上郡（範圍約略）
noteEn: "Wei then gave up all fifteen counties of Shang commandery in apology." Wei cedes Shang commandery.

note: 「貶蜀王，更號為侯，而使陳莊相蜀」（資治通鑑·卷3） 秦滅蜀、巴（範圍約略）
noteEn: "The King of Shu was reduced in rank and restyled a marquis, and Chen Zhuang was made chancellor of Shu." Qin destroys Shu and Ba.

note: 「春，秦師及楚戰于丹陽，楚師大敗，斬甲士八萬，虜屈匄及列侯、執珪七十餘人，遂取漢中郡」（資治通鑑·卷3） 秦取楚漢中（範圍約略）
noteEn: "In spring the army of Qin fought Chu at Danyang; the army of Chu was routed, eighty thousand armoured men were beheaded, Qu Gai and more than seventy lords and officers were taken, and Hanzhong commandery was seized." Qin takes Hanzhong from Chu.

note: 概覽（約略）
「趙王略中山地，至寧葭；西略胡地，至榆中」（資治通鑑·卷3） 趙武靈王胡服騎射，北拓雲中、九原（《通鑑》記其西略胡地在前306年）（範圍約略）
noteEn: "The King of Zhao raided the land of Zhongshan as far as Ningjia, and westward the land of the Hu as far as Yuzhong." King Wuling of Zhao adopts Hu dress and mounted archery and pushes north to Yunzhong and Jiuyuan (the Tongjian puts the western raid in 306 BCE).

note: 概覽（約略） 秦開破東胡，燕置五郡
noteEn: Qin Kai breaks the Eastern Hu, and Yan sets up five commanderies.

note: 「趙主父與齊、燕共滅中山，遷其王於膚施」（資治通鑑·卷4） 趙滅中山（範圍約略）
noteEn: "The Master Father of Zhao, with Qi and Yan, destroyed Zhongshan and moved its king to Fushi." Zhao destroys Zhongshan.

note: 「魏獻安邑以和，秦出其人歸之魏」（資治通鑑·卷4） 魏獻安邑（範圍約略）
noteEn: "Wei offered Anyi for peace; Qin sent its people out and returned them to Wei." Wei cedes Anyi.

note: 「齊湣王起兵伐之，民散，城不守」「宋王奔魏，死於溫」（資治通鑑·卷4） 齊滅宋（範圍約略）
noteEn: "King Min of Qi raised an army against it; the people scattered and the walls were not held." "The King of Song fled to Wei and died at Wen." Qi destroys Song.

note: 「六月之間，下齊七十餘城，皆為郡縣」（資治通鑑·卷4） 燕將樂毅破齊，下七十餘城（範圍約略）
noteEn: "In six months more than seventy cities of Qi fell, and all were made commanderies and counties." Yue Yi, general of Yan, breaks Qi and takes more than seventy cities.

note: 概覽（約略） 莊蹻王滇
noteEn: Zhuang Qiao makes himself king in Dian.

note: 田單以火牛破燕，復齊城（史記·田單列傳）
noteEn: Tian Dan breaks the army of Yan with oxen set alight and recovers the cities of Qi.

note: 概覽（約略）
概覽（約略）
「秦大良造白起伐楚，拔郢，燒夷陵」（資治通鑑·卷4） 白起拔郢，楚徙陳（範圍約略）
noteEn: "Bai Qi, Grand Excellent Achiever of Qin, attacked Chu, took Ying and burned Yiling." Bai Qi takes Ying, and Chu moves to Chen.

note: 「秦武安君定巫、黔中，初置黔中郡」（資治通鑑·卷4） 秦取黔中（範圍約略）
noteEn: "The Lord of Wu'an of Qin secured Wu and Qianzhong, and Qianzhong commandery was first set up." Qin takes Qianzhong.

note: 概覽（約略） 秦滅義渠
noteEn: Qin destroys the Yiqu.

note: 「上黨路絕，上黨守馮亭與其民謀曰：「鄭道已絕，秦兵日進，韓不能應，不如以上黨歸趙」（資治通鑑·卷5） 韓上黨降趙（範圍約略）
noteEn: "The road to Shangdang was cut, and its governor Feng Ting planned with his people: the road to Zheng is cut, the army of Qin comes on daily, Han cannot answer; better to give Shangdang to Zhao." Han's Shangdang goes over to Zhao.

note: 長平之戰，「前後斬首虜四十五萬人」（史記·白起王翦列傳）
noteEn: The battle of Changping: "four hundred and fifty thousand beheaded or taken, first and last".

note: 「秦王使將軍摎攻西周，〔西周君〕(赧王)入秦，頓首受罪，盡獻其邑三十六，口三萬」（資治通鑑·卷5） 秦滅周（範圍約略）
noteEn: "The King of Qin sent the general Jiu to attack West Zhou; its lord came to Qin, bowed his head and took the blame, and gave up all his thirty-six towns and thirty thousand people." Qin destroys Zhou.

note: 「楚滅魯，遷魯頃公於卞，為家人」（資治通鑑·卷6） 楚滅魯（《通鑑》在前249年；所據本前256年下亦補此文）（範圍約略）
noteEn: "Chu destroyed Lu and moved Duke Qing of Lu to Bian as a commoner." Chu destroys Lu (249 BCE in the Tongjian; the copy used also adds this under 256).

note: 「王齕攻上黨諸城，悉拔之，初置太原郡」（資治通鑑·卷6）（範圍約略）
noteEn: "Wang He attacked the cities of Shangdang and took them all; Taiyuan commandery was first set up."

note: 「內史〔騰〕(勝)滅韓，虜韓王安，以其地置潁川郡」（資治通鑑·卷6） 秦滅韓（範圍約略）
noteEn: "The Clerk of the Capital Teng destroyed Han, took its king An, and made its land Yingchuan commandery." Qin destroys Han.

note: 「〔冬，十月〕，克邯鄲，虜趙王遷，〔盡定趙地〕」（資治通鑑·卷6） 秦破趙，虜趙王遷（範圍約略）
noteEn: "In winter, the tenth month, Handan fell and King Qian of Zhao was taken; all the land of Zhao was secured." Qin breaks Zhao and takes King Qian.

note: 「冬，十月，王翦拔薊，燕王及太子率其精兵東保遼東，李信急追之」（資治通鑑·卷7） 秦拔薊（範圍約略）
noteEn: "In winter, the tenth month, Wang Jian took Ji; the King of Yan and his heir led their best troops east to hold Liaodong, and Li Xin pursued them hard." Qin takes Ji.

note: 「魏王假降，殺之，遂滅魏」（資治通鑑·卷7） 秦滅魏（範圍約略）
noteEn: "King Jia of Wei surrendered and was killed, and so Wei was destroyed." Qin destroys Wei.

note: 「王翦、蒙武虜楚王負芻，以其地置(楚)郡」（資治通鑑·卷7） 秦滅楚（範圍約略）
noteEn: "Wang Jian and Meng Wu took Fuchu, King of Chu, and made his land a commandery." Qin destroys Chu.

note: 秦虜燕王喜、代王嘉；王翦定荊江南，置會稽郡（史記·秦始皇本紀）
noteEn: Qin takes King Xi of Yan and King Jia of Dai; Wang Jian secures the land of Chu south of the Yangtze, and Kuaiji commandery is set up.

note: 秦王政二十六年，得齊王建，初并天下（史記·秦始皇本紀）
noteEn: In the twenty-sixth year of King Zheng of Qin, King Jian of Qi is taken, and the world is united for the first time.

note: 秦初并天下，分天下以為三十六郡（史記·秦始皇本紀）
noteEn: Qin, having united the world, divides it into thirty-six commanderies.

note: 概覽（約略）
概覽（約略）
蒙恬北逐戎狄，收河南（史記·蒙恬列傳）
noteEn: Meng Tian drives the Rong and Di north and takes the land south of the Yellow River's bend.

note: 概覽（約略） 秦置南海、桂林、象郡（象郡所在諸說不一）
noteEn: Qin sets up Nanhai, Guilin and Xiang commanderies (where Xiang lay is disputed).

note: 大澤鄉起事，陳勝立為張楚（史記·陳涉世家）
noteEn: The rising at Daze; Chen Sheng sets up Zhang Chu.

note: 概覽（約略） 冒頓單于；秦末匈奴復取河南地
noteEn: The chanyu Modu; at the end of Qin the Xiongnu take back the land south of the bend.

note: 概覽（約略） 六國後裔復立，細部未錄
noteEn: The heirs of the six states are set up again; the detail is not entered.

note: 概覽（約略） 章邯破陳勝
noteEn: Zhang Han breaks Chen Sheng.

note: 「秦王子嬰素車白馬，系頸以組，封皇帝璽符節，降軹道旁。」（史記·高祖本紀）秦亡；至分封前各地歸屬未錄（約略）
noteEn: "Ziying, King of Qin, in a plain carriage with white horses, a cord round his neck, the emperor's seal, tallies and staff sealed up, surrendered beside the Zhi road." Qin falls; who held what until the kingdoms were given out is not entered.

note: 項羽分封，自立為西楚霸王（約略）
noteEn: Xiang Yu gives out the kingdoms and makes himself Hegemon-King of Western Chu.

note: 劉邦受封漢王，王巴、蜀、漢中（約略）
noteEn: Liu Bang is made King of Han, ruling Ba, Shu and Hanzhong.

note: 項羽分封十八王，原秦地各歸諸王（史記·項羽本紀）；未明確分屬的郡縣此處概括為諸侯（約略）
noteEn: Xiang Yu sets up eighteen kings, and the lands of Qin go to them; commanderies whose holder is not stated are shown here simply as the lords'.

note: 「項王乃立章邯為雍王，王咸陽以西，都廢邱。」（史記·項羽本紀）
noteEn: "King Xiang then set up Zhang Han as King of Yong, ruling west of Xianyang, with his capital at Feiqiu."

note: 「王咸陽以西」（史記·項羽本紀）（疆域以都城所在郡為準，其餘為約略）
noteEn: "Ruling west of Xianyang." The land shown is the commandery of the capital; the rest is approximate.

note: 「故立司馬欣為塞王，王咸陽以東至河，都櫟陽」（史記·項羽本紀）
noteEn: "So he set up Sima Xin as King of Sai, ruling from Xianyang east to the River, with his capital at Yueyang."

note: 「立董翳為翟王，王上郡，都高奴。」（史記·項羽本紀）
noteEn: "He set up Dong Yi as King of Di, ruling Shang commandery, with his capital at Gaonu."

note: 「王上郡」（史記·項羽本紀）（疆域以都城所在郡為準，其餘為約略）
noteEn: "Ruling Shang commandery." The land shown is the commandery of the capital; the rest is approximate.

note: 「徙魏王豹為西魏王，王河東，都平陽。」（史記·項羽本紀）
noteEn: "He moved Bao, King of Wei, to be King of Western Wei, ruling Hedong, with his capital at Pingyang."

note: 「王河東」（史記·項羽本紀）（疆域以都城所在郡為準，其餘為約略）
noteEn: "Ruling Hedong." The land shown is the commandery of the capital; the rest is approximate.

note: 「故立申陽為河南王，都雒陽。」（史記·項羽本紀）
noteEn: "So he set up Shen Yang as King of Henan, with his capital at Luoyang."

note: 「都雒陽」（史記·項羽本紀）（疆域以都城所在郡為準，其餘為約略）
noteEn: "With his capital at Luoyang." The land shown is the commandery of the capital; the rest is approximate.

note: 「韓王成因故都，都陽翟。」（史記·項羽本紀）
noteEn: "Cheng, King of Han, kept the old capital, at Yangdi."

note: 「故立卬為殷王，王河內，都朝歌。」（史記·項羽本紀）
noteEn: "So he set up Ang as King of Yin, ruling Henei, with his capital at Zhaoge."

note: 「徙趙王歇為代王。」（史記·項羽本紀）
noteEn: "He moved Xie, King of Zhao, to be King of Dai."

note: 「徙趙王歇為代王」（史記·項羽本紀）（疆域以都城所在郡為準，其餘為約略）
noteEn: "He moved Xie, King of Zhao, to be King of Dai." The land shown is the commandery of the capital; the rest is approximate.

note: 「故立耳為常山王，王趙地，都襄國。」（史記·項羽本紀）
noteEn: "So he set up Er as King of Changshan, ruling the land of Zhao, with his capital at Xiangguo."

note: 「王趙地」（史記·項羽本紀）（疆域以都城所在郡為準，其餘為約略）
noteEn: "Ruling the land of Zhao." The land shown is the commandery of the capital; the rest is approximate.

note: 「故立布為九江王，都六。」（史記·項羽本紀）
noteEn: "So he set up Bu as King of Jiujiang, with his capital at Liu."

note: 「九江王，都六」（史記·項羽本紀）（疆域以都城所在郡為準，其餘為約略）
noteEn: "King of Jiujiang, with his capital at Liu." The land shown is the commandery of the capital; the rest is approximate.

note: 「故立芮為衡山王，都邾。」（史記·項羽本紀）
noteEn: "So he set up Rui as King of Hengshan, with his capital at Zhu."

note: 「都邾」（史記·項羽本紀）（疆域以都城所在郡為準，其餘為約略）
noteEn: "With his capital at Zhu." The land shown is the commandery of the capital; the rest is approximate.

note: 「因立敖為臨江王，都江陵。」（史記·項羽本紀）
noteEn: "And so he set up Ao as King of Linjiang, with his capital at Jiangling."

note: 「都江陵」（史記·項羽本紀）（疆域以都城所在郡為準，其餘為約略）
noteEn: "With his capital at Jiangling." The land shown is the commandery of the capital; the rest is approximate.

note: 「徙燕王韓廣為遼東王。」（史記·項羽本紀）
noteEn: "He moved Han Guang, King of Yan, to be King of Liaodong."

note: 「遼東王」（史記·項羽本紀）（疆域以都城所在郡為準，其餘為約略）
noteEn: "King of Liaodong." The land shown is the commandery of the capital; the rest is approximate.

note: 「故立荼為燕王，都薊。」（史記·項羽本紀）
noteEn: "So he set up Tu as King of Yan, with his capital at Ji."

note: 「都薊」（史記·項羽本紀）（疆域以都城所在郡為準，其餘為約略）
noteEn: "With his capital at Ji." The land shown is the commandery of the capital; the rest is approximate.

note: 「徙齊王田市為膠東王。」（史記·項羽本紀）（都即墨）
noteEn: "He moved Tian Fu, King of Qi, to be King of Jiaodong." His capital was Jimo.

note: 「故立都為齊王，都臨菑。」（史記·項羽本紀）
noteEn: "So he set up Du as King of Qi, with his capital at Linzi."

note: 「都臨菑」（史記·項羽本紀）（疆域以都城所在郡為準，其餘為約略）
noteEn: "With his capital at Linzi." The land shown is the commandery of the capital; the rest is approximate.

note: 「故立安為濟北王，都博陽。」（史記·項羽本紀）
noteEn: "So he set up An as King of Jibei, with his capital at Boyang."

note: 「都博陽」（史記·項羽本紀）（疆域以都城所在郡為準，其餘為約略）
noteEn: "With his capital at Boyang." The land shown is the commandery of the capital; the rest is approximate.

note: 「項王自立為西楚霸王，王九郡，都彭城。」（史記·項羽本紀）九郡所指未詳（約略）
noteEn: "King Xiang made himself Hegemon-King of Western Chu, ruling nine commanderies, with his capital at Pengcheng." Which nine is not known.

note: 「臧荼之國，因逐韓廣之遼東，廣弗聽，荼擊殺廣無終，並王其地。」（史記·項羽本紀）
noteEn: "Zang Tu went to his kingdom and set about driving Han Guang to Liaodong; Guang would not go, and Tu attacked and killed him at Wuzhong and ruled his land as well."

note: 「榮因自立為齊王，而西殺擊濟北王田安，并王三齊。」（史記·項羽本紀）
noteEn: "Rong then made himself King of Qi, went west and killed Tian An, King of Jibei, and ruled all three parts of Qi."

note: 「漢王遂定雍地。東至咸陽，引兵圍雍王廢丘，而遣諸將略定隴西、北地、上郡。」（史記·高祖本紀）
noteEn: "The King of Han then secured the land of Yong. He went east to Xianyang, led his troops to besiege the King of Yong at Feiqiu, and sent his generals to secure Longxi, Beidi and Shang commanderies."

note: 「引兵圍雍王廢丘」（史記·高祖本紀）（廢丘即槐里）
noteEn: "Led his troops to besiege the King of Yong at Feiqiu." Feiqiu is Huaili.

note: 「陳餘悉發三縣兵，與齊并力擊常山，大破之。張耳走歸漢。陳餘迎故趙王歇於代，反之趙。」（史記·項羽本紀）
noteEn: "Chen Yu raised all the troops of his three counties and with Qi attacked Changshan and routed it. Zhang Er fled to Han. Chen Yu fetched Xie, the former King of Zhao, from Dai and restored him to Zhao."

note: 「二年，漢王東略地，塞王欣、翟王翳、河南王申陽皆降。韓王昌不聽，使韓信擊破之。」（史記·高祖本紀）
noteEn: "In the second year the King of Han went east taking land; Xin, King of Sai, Yi, King of Di, and Shen Yang, King of Henan, all surrendered. Chang, king of the old state of Han, would not, and Han Xin was sent to defeat him."

note: 「三月，漢王從臨晉渡，魏王豹將兵從。下河內，虜殷王，置河內郡。」（史記·高祖本紀）
noteEn: "In the third month the King of Han crossed at Linjin, and Bao, King of Wei, followed with his troops. He took Henei, captured the King of Yin, and set up Henei commandery."

note: 「引水灌廢丘，廢丘降，章邯自殺。」（史記·高祖本紀）
noteEn: "He led water to flood Feiqiu; Feiqiu surrendered and Zhang Han killed himself."

note: 「是時九江王布與龍且戰，不勝，與隨何閒行歸漢。」（史記·高祖本紀）
noteEn: "At this time Bu, King of Jiujiang, fought Long Ju and lost, and with Sui He made his way by back roads to Han."

note: 「遂定魏地，置三郡，曰河東、太原、上黨。」（史記·高祖本紀）「信遂虜豹，定魏爲河東郡。」（史記·淮陰侯列傳）
noteEn: "So the land of Wei was secured and three commanderies set up: Hedong, Taiyuan and Shangdang." "Xin then captured Bao and made Wei into Hedong commandery."

note: 「後九月，破代兵，禽夏說閼與。」（史記·淮陰侯列傳）
noteEn: "In the intercalary ninth month he broke the army of Dai and captured Xia Yue at Yuyu."

note: 「破代兵」（史記·淮陰侯列傳）（代國所轄，約略）
noteEn: "Broke the army of Dai." What Dai held is approximate.

note: 「是時九江王布與龍且戰，不勝，與隨何閒行歸漢。」（史記·高祖本紀）九江其餘諸郡歸屬未詳（約略）
noteEn: "At this time Bu, King of Jiujiang, fought Long Ju and lost, and with Sui He made his way by back roads to Han." Who held the other commanderies of Jiujiang is not known.

note: 「漢王乃令張耳與韓信遂東下井陘擊趙，斬陳餘、趙王歇。」（史記·高祖本紀）
noteEn: "The King of Han then ordered Zhang Er and Han Xin to go east down the Jingxing pass and attack Zhao; they beheaded Chen Yu and Xie, King of Zhao."

note: 概覽（約略） 趙佗自立南越
noteEn: Zhao Tuo sets himself up in Nanyue.

note: 「漢四年，遂皆降平齊。」（史記·淮陰侯列傳）（韓信旋立為齊王）
noteEn: "In the fourth year of Han all of Qi surrendered and was pacified." Han Xin was soon made King of Qi.

note: 垓下之後，「使騎將灌嬰追殺項羽東城，斬首八萬，遂略定楚地。」（史記·高祖本紀）（諸侯王國在漢的名義下，細部未錄；約略）
noteEn: After Gaixia: "the cavalry general Guan Ying was sent to pursue and kill Xiang Yu at Dongcheng; eighty thousand were beheaded, and the land of Chu was secured." The kingdoms stand under the name of Han; their detail is not entered.

note: 概覽（約略）
概覽（約略） 衛滿據朝鮮
noteEn: Wei Man holds Joseon.

note: 概覽（約略） 南越兼甌雒
noteEn: Nanyue absorbs Ouluo (Au Lac).

note: 概覽（約略） 匈奴逐月氏，役屬西域
noteEn: The Xiongnu drive out the Yuezhi and make the Western Regions their subjects.

note: 概覽（約略）
概覽（約略）
概覽（約略）
概覽（約略） 閩越內亂歸漢
noteEn: Minyue, in turmoil, submits to Han.

note: 概覽（約略） 衛青取河南地，置朔方
noteEn: Wei Qing takes the land south of the bend, and Shuofang is set up.

note: 霍去病出隴西，渾邪王降，河西入漢（史記·衛將軍驃騎列傳）
noteEn: Huo Qubing marches out of Longxi, the Hunye king surrenders, and the Hexi corridor passes to Han.

note: 概覽（約略） 漢滅南越，置九郡
noteEn: Han destroys Nanyue and sets up nine commanderies.

note: 概覽（約略） 漢置敦煌郡，開西南夷
noteEn: Han sets up Dunhuang commandery and opens the lands of the south-western peoples.

note: 概覽（約略） 漢滅閩越
noteEn: Han destroys Minyue.

note: 概覽（約略） 滇王降，置益州郡
noteEn: The King of Dian surrenders, and Yizhou commandery is set up.

note: 概覽（約略） 漢滅衛氏朝鮮，置四郡
noteEn: Han destroys Wei Man's Joseon and sets up four commanderies.

note: 概覽（約略） 趙充國擊羌，屯田湟中
noteEn: Zhao Chongguo campaigns against the Qiang and plants garrison farms in Huangzhong.

note: 鄭吉並護南北道，「都護之起，自吉置矣」（漢書·西域傳上）
noteEn: Zheng Ji is given charge of both the northern and the southern road: "the office of Protector-General began with Ji".

note: 概覽（約略）
概覽（約略） 漢罷珠崖郡
noteEn: Han gives up Zhuya commandery.

note: 概覽（約略） 高句麗都國內城
noteEn: Goguryeo has its capital at Gungnae.

note: 王莽「即真天子位，定有天下之號曰新」（漢書·王莽傳上）
noteEn: Wang Mang "took the throne as Son of Heaven in his own right and fixed the name of his rule over the world as Xin".

note: 概覽（約略） 焉耆殺都護，西域絕
noteEn: Yanqi kills the Protector-General, and the Western Regions are cut off.

note: 「九月庚戌，三輔豪桀共誅王莽，傳首詣宛。」（後漢書·光武帝紀上）更始起後，各地豪桀「皆殺其牧守，自稱將軍，用漢年號」（後漢書·劉玄劉盆子傳）
noteEn: "In the ninth month, on the day gengxu, the great men of the capital region together killed Wang Mang, and his head was sent to Wan." After the rising of the Gengshi emperor the great men everywhere "killed their governors, called themselves generals and used the calendar of Han".

note: 「於是進兵虜之，以徇百姓，然後行戮，安定悉降。」「囂遂分遣諸將徇隴西、武都、金城、武威、張掖、酒泉、敦煌，皆下之。」（後漢書·隗囂公孫述傳）起兵應漢，奉更始
noteEn: "So he advanced and captured him, paraded him before the people and put him to death, and all Anding surrendered." "Xiao then sent his officers to take Longxi, Wudu, Jincheng, Wuwei, Zhangye, Jiuquan and Dunhuang, and all fell." He rose for Han and served the Gengshi emperor.

note: 「莽敗，憲據郡自守。更始元年，自稱淮南王。」（後漢書·王劉張李彭盧傳）（廬江郡）
noteEn: "When Mang fell, Xian held his commandery. In the first year of Gengshi he called himself King of Huainan." The commandery was Lujiang.

note: 「十二月，立郎為天子，都邯鄲，遂遣使者降下郡國。」（後漢書·光武帝紀上）信都為更始守，不從
noteEn: "In the twelfth month Lang was set up as Son of Heaven with his capital at Handan, and envoys were sent to bring the commanderies and kingdoms over." Xindu held out for the Gengshi emperor.

note: 「於是趙國以北，遼東以西，皆從風而靡。」（後漢書·王劉張李彭盧傳）邊郡僅名義歸附
noteEn: "So everything north of Zhao and west of Liaodong bent before the wind." The border commanderies came over in name only.

note: 「四月，進圍邯鄲，連戰破之。五月甲辰，拔其城，誅王郎。」（後漢書·光武帝紀上）劉秀此時仍奉更始，旋受封蕭王
noteEn: "In the fourth month he advanced to besiege Handan and won battle after battle. In the fifth month, on the day jiachen, he took the city and put Wang Lang to death." Liu Xiu still served the Gengshi emperor, and was soon made King of Xiao.

note: 「先遣吳漢北發十郡兵。幽州牧苗曾不從，漢遂斬曾而發其衆。」（後漢書·光武帝紀上）（幽州諸郡，約略）
noteEn: "He first sent Wu Han north to raise the troops of ten commanderies. Miao Zeng, governor of Youzhou, would not comply; Han beheaded him and raised his men." The commanderies of Youzhou, approximately.

note: 「使吳漢、岑彭襲殺謝躬於鄴。」（後漢書·光武帝紀上）「乃拜恂河內太守，行大將軍事。」（後漢書·鄧禹寇恂傳）
noteEn: "He sent Wu Han and Cen Peng to surprise and kill Xie Gong at Ye." "He then made Xun governor of Henei, acting as general-in-chief."

note: 「更始二年，遣使征囂及崔、義等。囂將行，方望以為更始未可知，固止之，囂不聽。」（後漢書·隗囂公孫述傳）囂入長安，其地暫歸更始（約略）
noteEn: "In the second year of Gengshi envoys summoned Xiao with Cui and Yi. Xiao was about to go; Fang Wang, who thought Gengshi's future uncertain, tried hard to stop him, and Xiao would not listen." Xiao went to Chang'an, and his land passed for a time to Gengshi.

note: 「攻下濟陰、山陽、沛、楚、淮陽、汝南，凡得二十八城。」（後漢書·王劉張李彭盧傳）「梁王劉永擅命睢陽」（後漢書·光武帝紀上）
noteEn: "He attacked and took Jiyin, Shanyang, Pei, Chu, Huaiyang and Runan, twenty-eight cities in all." "Liu Yong, King of Liang, ruled at Suiyang on his own authority."

note: 「攻下濟陰、山陽、沛、楚、淮陽、汝南，凡得二十八城」（後漢書·王劉張李彭盧傳）汝南僅得其部分城邑（約略）
noteEn: "He attacked and took Jiyin, Shanyang, Pei, Chu, Huaiyang and Runan, twenty-eight cities in all." Of Runan he held only some towns.

note: 「南郡人秦豐據黎丘，自稱楚黎王，略十有二縣」（後漢書·岑彭傳）（十二縣所在，約略）
noteEn: "Qin Feng, a man of Nan commandery, held Liqiu, called himself King Li of Chu, and took twelve counties." Where the twelve lay is approximate.

note: 「田戎起夷陵」（後漢書·光武帝紀上）「時田戎擁眾夷陵」（後漢書·岑彭傳）
noteEn: "Tian Rong rose at Yiling." "At that time Tian Rong held Yiling with his following."

note: 「張步起琅邪」（後漢書·光武帝紀上）
noteEn: "Zhang Bu rose in Langya."

note: 「是時東海人董憲起兵據其郡」（後漢書·王劉張李彭盧傳）
noteEn: "At this time Dong Xian, a man of Donghai, raised troops and held his commandery."

note: 「建武元年四月，遂自立為天子，號成家。」…「越巂任貴亦殺王莽大尹而據郡降。」…「於是盡有益州之地。」（後漢書·隗囂公孫述傳）
noteEn: "In the fourth month of the first year of Jianwu he made himself Son of Heaven, with the title Chengjia." "Ren Gui of Yuexi also killed Wang Mang's governor, held the commandery and surrendered." "So he held all the land of Yizhou."

note: 「甲子，前將軍鄧禹擊更始定國公王匡於安邑，大破之，斬其將劉均。」（後漢書·光武帝紀上）
noteEn: "On the day jiazi the General of the Van Deng Yu attacked Gengshi's Duke of Dingguo, Wang Kuang, at Anyi, routed him and beheaded his officer Liu Jun."

note: 「九月，赤眉入長安，更始奔高陵。」（後漢書·光武帝紀上）
noteEn: "In the ninth month the Red Eyebrows entered Chang'an, and Gengshi fled to Gaoling."

note: 「辛卯，朱鮪舉城降。」「冬十月癸丑，車駕入洛陽，幸南宮却非殿，遂定都焉。」（後漢書·光武帝紀上）
noteEn: "On the day xinmao Zhu Wei surrendered the city." "In winter, the tenth month, on the day guichou, the emperor entered Luoyang and lodged in the Quefei Hall of the Southern Palace, and the capital was fixed there."

note: 「亡歸天水。復招聚其眾，據故地，自稱西州上將軍。」（後漢書·隗囂公孫述傳）「赤眉殺更始，而隗嚻據隴右」（後漢書·光武帝紀上）
noteEn: "He fled home to Tianshui, gathered his following again, held his old land and called himself Supreme General of the Western Province." "The Red Eyebrows killed Gengshi, and Wei Xiao held Longyou."

note: 北地何時屬囂未詳；建武六年詔書已稱「天水、隴西、安定、北地吏人爲隗嚻所詿誤者」（後漢書·光武帝紀下）
noteEn: When Beidi came under Xiao is not known; an edict of the sixth year of Jianwu already speaks of "the officers and people of Tianshui, Longxi, Anding and Beidi led astray by Wei Xiao".

note: 「乃推融行河西五郡大將軍事。」「於是以梁統為武威太守，史苞為張掖太守，竺曾為酒泉太守，辛肜為敦煌太守，厙鈞為金城太守。」（後漢書·竇融傳）
noteEn: "So they put Rong forward to act as general-in-chief of the five commanderies west of the River." "Liang Tong was then made governor of Wuwei, Shi Bao of Zhangye, Zhu Zeng of Jiuquan, Xin Rong of Dunhuang and She Jun of Jincheng."

note: 「而張步亦定齊地」（後漢書·王劉張李彭盧傳）「故步得專集齊地，據郡十二。」（後漢書·王劉張李彭盧傳）（各郡所屬，約略）
noteEn: "And Zhang Bu secured the land of Qi." "So Bu was able to gather the land of Qi to himself and held twelve commanderies." Which commanderies is approximate.

note: 「赤眉殺更始」（後漢書·光武帝紀上）；更始所餘郡縣此後陸續歸附光武，各郡時日多未詳（約略）
noteEn: "The Red Eyebrows killed Gengshi." The commanderies Gengshi still held came over to Guangwu one after another; for most the date is not known.

note: 「董訢起堵鄉；許邯起杏；又，更始諸將各擁兵據南陽諸城。」（後漢書·岑彭傳）「破虜將軍鄧奉據淯陽反。」（後漢書·光武帝紀上）
noteEn: "Dong Xin rose at Duxiang; Xu Han rose at Xing; and Gengshi's generals each held a city of Nanyang with their troops." "The Caitiff-Breaking General Deng Feng held Yuyang and rebelled."

note: 江夏、武陵、長沙、桂陽、零陵及交州諸郡至建武五年始「相率遣使貢獻」（後漢書·岑彭傳），此前歸屬未詳
noteEn: Jiangxia, Wuling, Changsha, Guiyang, Lingling and the commanderies of Jiaozhou only in the fifth year of Jianwu "one after another sent envoys with tribute"; whose they were before that is not known.

note: 益州太守文齊拒公孫述，「聞光武即位，乃間道遣使自聞」；牂柯「與郡功曹謝暹保境爲漢」（後漢書·西南夷傳）
noteEn: Wen Qi, governor of Yizhou commandery, held out against Gongsun Shu and, "hearing that Guangwu had taken the throne, sent envoys by back roads to report himself"; in Zangke they "with the commandery's officer Xie Xian held the borders for Han".

note: 「初，樂浪人王調據郡不服。」（後漢書·光武帝紀下）（始於何年未詳）
noteEn: "Earlier Wang Tiao, a man of Lelang, had held the commandery and would not submit." The year it began is not known.

note: 「是月，赤眉焚西京宮室，發掘園陵，寇掠關中。大司徒鄧禹入長安」「延岑大破赤眉於杜陵。」（後漢書·光武帝紀上）關中諸軍並爭
noteEn: "In this month the Red Eyebrows burned the palaces of the western capital, dug up the imperial tombs and plundered Guanzhong. The Grand Minister over the Masses Deng Yu entered Chang'an." "Yan Cen routed the Red Eyebrows at Duling." The armies in Guanzhong fought one another.

note: 「蓋延拔睢陽，劉永奔譙。」（後漢書·光武帝紀上）
noteEn: "Gai Yan took Suiyang, and Liu Yong fled to Qiao."

note: 「漁陽太守彭寵反，攻幽州牧朱浮於薊。」（後漢書·光武帝紀上）
noteEn: "Peng Chong, governor of Yuyang, rebelled and attacked Zhu Fu, governor of Youzhou, at Ji."

note: 「丙午，赤眉君臣面縛，奉高皇帝璽綬」「馮異與延岑戰於上林，破之。」（後漢書·光武帝紀上）
noteEn: "On the day bingwu the Red Eyebrows, lord and ministers, came with their hands bound and offered up the seal and ribbon of the High Emperor." "Feng Yi fought Yan Cen at Shanglin and defeated him."

note: 「夏四月，大破鄧奉於小長安，斬之。」（後漢書·光武帝紀上）
noteEn: "In summer, the fourth month, Deng Feng was routed at Xiao Chang'an and beheaded."

note: 「彭寵陷薊城，寵自立為燕王。」（後漢書·光武帝紀上）
noteEn: "Peng Chong took the city of Ji and made himself King of Yan."

note: 「明年春，寵遂拔右北平、上谷數縣。」（後漢書·王劉張李彭盧傳）所得幾何未詳
noteEn: "In spring of the next year Chong took several counties of Youbeiping and Shanggu." How much he took is not known.

note: 「秦豐相趙京舉宜城降，拜為成漢將軍，與彭共圍豐於黎丘。」（後漢書·岑彭傳）
noteEn: "Zhao Jing, Qin Feng's chancellor, surrendered Yicheng, was made General Who Completes Han, and with Peng besieged Feng at Liqiu."

note: 「蓋延拔睢陽，獲劉永」（後漢書·光武帝紀上）；淮陽、濟陰、楚、汝南歸漢時日未詳（約略）
noteEn: "Gai Yan took Suiyang and captured Liu Yong." When Huaiyang, Jiyin, Chu and Runan came to Han is not known.

note: 「茂奔下邳與董憲合」（後漢書·王劉張李彭盧傳）
noteEn: "Mao fled to Xiapi and joined Dong Xian."

note: 「捕虜將軍馬武、偏將軍王霸拔垂惠。」（後漢書·光武帝紀上）
noteEn: "The Caitiff-Catching General Ma Wu and the lieutenant-general Wang Ba took Chuihui."

note: 「彭寵為其蒼頭所殺，漁陽平。」（後漢書·光武帝紀上）
noteEn: "Peng Chong was killed by his own slaves, and Yuyang was pacified."

note: 「遣征南大將軍岑彭率二將軍伐田戎於津郷，大破之。」（後漢書·光武帝紀上）「遂拔夷陵，追至秭歸。」（後漢書·岑彭傳）
noteEn: "The Great General Who Subdues the South Cen Peng was sent with two generals against Tian Rong at Jinxiang, and routed him." "He then took Yiling and pursued him to Zigui."

note: 「六月，建義大將軍朱祐拔黎丘，獲秦豐」（後漢書·光武帝紀上）
noteEn: "In the sixth month the Great General Who Establishes Righteousness Zhu You took Liqiu and captured Qin Feng."

note: 「車駕轉徇彭城、下邳。吳漢拔郯，獲劉紆」（後漢書·光武帝紀上）「梁地悉平」（後漢書·王劉張李彭盧傳）
noteEn: "The emperor went on to Pengcheng and Xiapi. Wu Han took Tan and captured Liu Yu." "The land of Liang was all pacified."

note: 「耿弇等與張步戰於臨淄，大破之。帝幸臨淄，進幸劇。張步斬蘇茂以降，齊地平。」（後漢書·光武帝紀上）
noteEn: "Geng Yan and others fought Zhang Bu at Linzi and routed him. The emperor went to Linzi and on to Ju. Zhang Bu beheaded Su Mao and surrendered, and the land of Qi was pacified."

note: 「交阯牧鄧讓率七郡太守遣使奉貢。」（後漢書·光武帝紀上）江夏、武陵、長沙、桂陽、零陵諸郡亦「相率遣使貢獻」（後漢書·岑彭傳）
noteEn: "Deng Rang, governor of Jiaozhi, led the governors of seven commanderies in sending envoys with tribute." Jiangxia, Wuling, Changsha, Guiyang and Lingling also "one after another sent envoys with tribute".

note: 「十二月，盧芳自稱天子於九原。」（後漢書·光武帝紀上）「掠有五原、朔方、雲中、定襄、鴈門五郡，並置守令」（後漢書·王劉張李彭盧傳）
noteEn: "In the twelfth month Lu Fang called himself Son of Heaven at Jiuyuan." "He seized the five commanderies of Wuyuan, Shuofang, Yunzhong, Dingxiang and Yanmen and appointed governors and magistrates."

note: 「揚武將軍馬成等拔舒，獲李憲。」（後漢書·光武帝紀下）
noteEn: "The General Who Displays Might Ma Cheng and others took Shu and captured Li Xian."

note: 「二月，大司馬吳漢拔朐，獲董憲、龐萌，山東悉平。」（後漢書·光武帝紀下）
noteEn: "In the second month the Grand Marshal Wu Han took Qu and captured Dong Xian and Pang Meng, and all east of the mountains was pacified."

note: 「秋，遣樂浪太守王遵擊之，郡吏殺調降。」（後漢書·光武帝紀下）
noteEn: "In autumn Wang Zun, governor of Lelang, was sent against him, and the commandery's officers killed Tiao and surrendered."

note: 「冬，盧芳所置朔方太守田颯、雲中太守喬扈各舉郡降。」（後漢書·光武帝紀下）
noteEn: "In winter Tian Sa, the governor of Shuofang appointed by Lu Fang, and Qiao Hu, his governor of Yunzhong, each surrendered his commandery."

note: 「八年春正月，中郎將來歙襲略陽，殺隗嚻守將而據其城。」「隗嚻攻來歙，不能下。」（後漢書·光武帝紀下）
noteEn: "In spring of the eighth year, the first month, the General of the Household Lai Xi surprised Lueyang, killed Wei Xiao's commander there and held the city." "Wei Xiao attacked Lai Xi and could not take it."

note: 「公孫述遣將田戎、任滿據荊門。」（後漢書·光武帝紀下）「遂拔夷道、夷陵，據荊門、虎牙。」（後漢書·岑彭傳）
noteEn: "Gongsun Shu sent his generals Tian Rong and Ren Man to hold Jingmen." "They took Yidao and Yiling and held Jingmen and Huya."

note: 「冬十月，中郎將來歙等大破隗純於落門，其將王元奔蜀，純與周宗降，隴右平。」（後漢書·光武帝紀下）
noteEn: "In winter, the tenth month, the General of the Household Lai Xi and others routed Wei Chun at Luomen; his general Wang Yuan fled to Shu, Chun and Zhou Zong surrendered, and Longyou was pacified."

note: 「其將王元奔蜀」；次年公孫述將王元、環安據下辯（後漢書·光武帝紀下）（約略）
noteEn: "His general Wang Yuan fled to Shu." The next year Gongsun Shu's generals Wang Yuan and Huan An held Xiabian.

note: 「閏月，征南大將軍岑彭率三將軍與公孫述將田戎、任滿戰於荊門，大破之」「岑彭遂率舟師伐公孫述，平巴郡。」（後漢書·光武帝紀下）
noteEn: "In the intercalary month the Great General Who Subdues the South Cen Peng, with three generals, fought Gongsun Shu's generals Tian Rong and Ren Man at Jingmen and routed them." "Cen Peng then led the fleet against Gongsun Shu and pacified Ba commandery."

note: 「六月，中郎將來歙率揚武將軍馬成破公孫述將王元、環安於下辯。」（後漢書·光武帝紀下）
noteEn: "In the sixth month the General of the Household Lai Xi, leading the General Who Displays Might Ma Cheng, defeated Gongsun Shu's generals Wang Yuan and Huan An at Xiabian."

note: 「邛穀王任貴聞彭威信，數千里遣使迎降。」（後漢書·岑彭傳）
noteEn: "Ren Gui, King of Qionggu, hearing of Peng's power and good faith, sent envoys a thousand li to offer his surrender."

note: 「冬十一月戊寅，吳漢、臧宮與公孫述戰於成都，大破之。述被創，夜死。」（後漢書·光武帝紀下）；牂柯、益州郡此後實歸漢（約略）
noteEn: "In winter, the eleventh month, on the day wuyin, Wu Han and Zang Gong fought Gongsun Shu at Chengdu and routed him. Shu was wounded and died in the night." Zangke and Yizhou commandery came to Han in fact after this.

note: 「及隴、蜀平，詔融與五郡太守奏事京師」（後漢書·竇融傳）
noteEn: "When Long and Shu were pacified, Rong and the governors of the five commanderies were summoned to report at the capital."

note: 「盧芳自五原亡入匈奴。」（後漢書·光武帝紀下）（〈盧芳傳〉繫於建武十二年）
noteEn: "Lu Fang fled from Wuyuan to the Xiongnu." His biography puts it in the twelfth year of Jianwu.

note: 「十六年春二月，交阯女子徵側反，略有城邑。」（後漢書·光武帝紀下）
noteEn: "In spring of the sixteenth year, the second month, Zheng Ce (Trung Trac), a woman of Jiaozhi, rebelled and seized towns."

note: 「於是九眞、日南、合浦蠻里皆應之，凡略六十五城，自立爲王。交阯刺史及諸太守僅得自守。」（後漢書·南蠻傳）（合浦為馬援進軍之地，未列）
noteEn: "The Man and Li of Jiuzhen, Rinan and Hepu all answered her; she took sixty-five towns in all and made herself ruler. The inspector of Jiaozhi and the governors could do no more than hold their own." Hepu, from which Ma Yuan advanced, is not shown.

note: 「明年正月，斬徵側、徵貳，傳首洛陽。」（後漢書·馬援傳）南蠻傳作「明年夏四月」
noteEn: "In the first month of the next year Zheng Ce and Zheng Er were beheaded and their heads sent to Luoyang." The account of the southern peoples has "in summer of the next year, the fourth month".

note: 概覽（約略） 匈奴分裂，南單于附漢，北匈奴在漠北
noteEn: The Xiongnu split: the southern chanyu attaches himself to Han, and the northern Xiongnu are north of the desert.

note: 「竇固破呼衍王於天山，留兵屯伊吾盧城。」（後漢書·明帝紀）
noteEn: "Dou Gu defeated the Huyan king at the Tian Shan and left troops to garrison the town of Yiwulu."

note: 「擊破白山虜於蒲類海上，遂入車師。初置西域都護、戊己校尉。」（後漢書·明帝紀）
noteEn: "They defeated the Baishan horde on Lake Pulei and went on into Jushi. The Protector-General of the Western Regions and the Wu and Ji Colonels were set up for the first time."

note: 「焉耆、龜茲攻西域都護陳睦，悉沒其衆。」（後漢書·明帝紀）
noteEn: "Yanqi and Qiuci attacked the Protector-General Chen Mu and destroyed his whole force."

note: 「酒泉太守段彭討擊車師，大破之。罷戊己校尉官。」（後漢書·章帝紀）
noteEn: "Duan Peng, governor of Jiuquan, attacked Jushi and routed it. The office of the Wu and Ji Colonels was abolished."

note: 「甲辰，罷伊吾盧屯兵。」（後漢書·章帝紀）
noteEn: "On the day jiachen the garrison of Yiwulu was withdrawn."

note: 概覽（約略） 竇憲破北匈奴，鮮卑據其地
noteEn: Dou Xian breaks the northern Xiongnu, and the Xianbei take their land.

note: 概覽（約略） 班超為西域都護
noteEn: Ban Chao is Protector-General of the Western Regions.

note: 概覽（約略） 漢罷西域都護
noteEn: Han gives up the Protectorate of the Western Regions.

note: 「延光二年夏，復以勇爲西域長史，將兵五百人出屯柳中。明年正月，勇至樓蘭，以鄯善歸附」（後漢書·班勇傳）
noteEn: "In summer of the second year of Yanguang, Yong was again made Chief Clerk of the Western Regions and led five hundred men out to garrison Liuzhong. In the first month of the next year he reached Loulan and brought Shanshan over."

note: 概覽（約略）
東漢末的起點：各郡國皆屬漢（此後的變動見各條）
noteEn: The starting point for the end of Eastern Han: every commandery and kingdom belongs to Han (the changes after this have their own entries).

note: 「其部師有三十六萬，皆著黃巾，同日反叛。安平、甘陵人各執其王以應之。」（後漢書·靈帝紀）黃巾所據範圍約略
noteEn: "His divisions had three hundred and sixty thousand men, all wearing yellow turbans, and rebelled on the same day. The men of Anping and Ganling each seized their king and joined them."

note: 「朱儁爲黃巾波才所敗。」「汝南黃巾敗太守趙謙於邵陵。」（後漢書·靈帝紀）黃巾所據範圍約略
noteEn: "Zhu Jun was defeated by Bo Cai of the Yellow Turbans." "The Yellow Turbans of Runan defeated the governor Zhao Qian at Shaoling."

note: 「五月，皇甫嵩、朱儁復與波才等戰於長社，大破之。」（後漢書·靈帝紀）
noteEn: "In the fifth month Huangfu Song and Zhu Jun again fought Bo Cai and the others at Changshe and routed them."

note: 「皇甫嵩、朱儁大破汝南黃巾於西華。」（後漢書·靈帝紀）
noteEn: "Huangfu Song and Zhu Jun routed the Yellow Turbans of Runan at Xihua."

note: 「後太守秦頡擊殺曼成，賊更以趙弘為帥，衆浸盛，遂十餘萬，據宛城。」（後漢書·朱儁傳）
noteEn: "Later the governor Qin Jie attacked and killed Mancheng; the rebels then took Zhao Hong as their leader, their numbers swelled to more than a hundred thousand, and they held the city of Wan."

note: 「冬十月，皇甫嵩與黃巾賊戰於廣宗，獲張角弟梁。」（後漢書·靈帝紀）各郡收復先後約略
noteEn: "In winter, the tenth month, Huangfu Song fought the Yellow Turban rebels at Guangzong and took Zhang Jue's younger brother Liang." The order in which the commanderies were recovered is approximate.

note: 「癸巳，朱儁拔宛城，斬黃巾別帥孫夏。」（後漢書·靈帝紀）
noteEn: "On the day guisi Zhu Jun took the city of Wan and beheaded Sun Xia, a Yellow Turban commander."

note: 「十一月，皇甫嵩又破黃巾于下曲陽，斬張角弟寶。」（後漢書·靈帝紀）各郡收復先後約略
noteEn: "In the eleventh month Huangfu Song again defeated the Yellow Turbans, at Xiaquyang, and beheaded Zhang Jue's younger brother Bao." The order in which the commanderies were recovered is approximate.

note: 「賊遂進圍漢陽。」「遂麾左右進兵，臨陣戰歿。」（後漢書·傅燮傳）
noteEn: "The rebels then advanced and besieged Hanyang." "He waved his men forward and fell fighting in the line."

note: 「瓚攻拔居庸，生獲虞，執虞還薊。」（三國志·公孫瓚傳）範圍約略
noteEn: "Zan attacked and took Juyong, captured Yu alive, and brought him back to Ji a prisoner."

note: 「走寧陵，又追之，走九江。」（三國志·武帝紀）範圍約略
noteEn: "He fled to Ningling; pursued again, he fled to Jiujiang."

note: 「策攻康，拔之。術復用其故吏劉勳爲太守」（三國志·孫策傳）
noteEn: "Ce attacked Kang and took the city. Shu instead made his old officer Liu Xun governor."

note: 「布夜走，太祖復攻，拔定陶，分兵平諸縣。」「兖州平」（三國志·武帝紀）
noteEn: "Bu fled by night; Taizu attacked again, took Dingtao, and sent detachments to pacify the counties." "Yanzhou was pacified."

note: 「渡江轉鬥，所向皆破」「劉繇棄軍遁逃，諸郡守皆捐城郭奔走。」（三國志·孫策傳）
noteEn: "He crossed the Yangtze and fought his way on, breaking all before him." "Liu Yao abandoned his army and fled, and the governors all left their walls and ran."

note: 「二月，太祖進軍討破之，斬辟、邵等，儀及其衆皆降。」（三國志·武帝紀）（汝南、潁川黃巾）
noteEn: "In the second month Taizu advanced and defeated them, beheading Pi, Shao and others; Yi and his following all surrendered." These were the Yellow Turbans of Runan and Yingchuan.

note: 「遂引兵渡浙江，據會稽，屠東冶，乃攻破虎等。盡更置長吏，策自領會稽太守」（三國志·孫策傳）
noteEn: "He then led his troops across the Zhe River, held Kuaiji, put Dongye to the sword, and then defeated Hu and the others. He replaced all the senior officials, and Ce himself took the governorship of Kuaiji."

note: 「城夜陷，乃奔東山，妻子爲譚所虜。」（後漢書·孔融傳）範圍約略
noteEn: "The city fell in the night; he fled to the eastern hills, and his wife and children were taken by Tan."

note: 「會術病死。」「洪、尚率衆降」（河內）「冬十一月，張繡率衆降，封列侯。」（三國志·武帝紀）
noteEn: "Just then Shu died of illness." "Hong and Shang surrendered with their men" (in Henei). "In winter, the eleventh month, Zhang Xiu surrendered with his men and was made a marquis."

note: 「策輕軍晨夜襲拔廬江，勳衆盡降」（三國志·孫策傳）（豫章諸郡，約略）
noteEn: "Ce, with a light force marching day and night, surprised and took Lujiang, and all Xun's men surrendered." The commanderies of Yuzhang, approximately.

note: 「表遂攻并懌，南收零、桂」（三國志·劉表傳）
noteEn: "Biao then attacked and absorbed Yi, and to the south took Lingling and Guiyang."

note: 「公圍壺關三月，拔之。」（三國志·武帝紀）範圍約略
noteEn: "The Duke besieged Huguan for three months and took it."

note: 「河西諸羌盡降，隴右平。」（三國志·夏侯淵傳）
noteEn: "All the Qiang west of the River surrendered, and Longyou was pacified."

note: 「割湘水，以零陵還之。」（三國志·呂蒙傳）
noteEn: "The line was drawn at the Xiang River, and Lingling was given back."

note: 「岱奮擊大破之」「於是除廣州，復為交州如故。」（三國志·呂岱傳）
noteEn: "Dai attacked with all his force and routed them." "Guangzhou was then abolished, and it was Jiaozhou again as before."

note: 概覽（約略） 楊茂搜據仇池
noteEn: Yang Maosou holds Chouchi.

note: 概覽（約略）
概覽（約略）
概覽（約略） 劉淵稱漢王於左國城（晉書·劉元海載記）
noteEn: Liu Yuan takes the title King of Han at Zuoguocheng.

note: 概覽（約略） 李雄據成都
noteEn: Li Xiong holds Chengdu.

note: 概覽（約略）
概覽（約略） 劉淵徙平陽
noteEn: Liu Yuan moves to Pingyang.

note: 概覽（約略） 拓跋猗盧受封代公
noteEn: Tuoba Yilu is made Duke of Dai.

note: 永嘉五年六月洛陽陷（晉書·孝懷帝紀）；其後洛陽一帶殘破，漢趙控制鬆散
noteEn: Luoyang falls in the sixth month of the fifth year of Yongjia; afterwards the country round it lies in ruins, and Han-Zhao's hold is loose.

note: 概覽（約略） 石勒據襄國，名義上奉漢
noteEn: Shi Le holds Xiangguo, in name serving Han.

note: 概覽（約略） 洛陽陷落後，北方郡縣多由塢主、流民帥據守，名義上奉晉
noteEn: After the fall of Luoyang most northern commanderies and counties are held by masters of forts and leaders of refugees, in name serving Jin.

note: 「遼東張統據樂浪、帶方二郡，與高句麗王乙弗利相攻，連年不解。」（資治通鑑·晉紀十）範圍約略
noteEn: "Zhang Tong of Liaodong held the two commanderies of Lelang and Daifang and fought Yifuli, King of Goguryeo, year after year without end."

note: 「勒升其廳事，命甲士執浚」「使其將王洛生驛送浚襄國市斬之」（晉書·石勒載記上）；石勒時名義上奉漢
noteEn: "Le went up into his hall and ordered his armoured men to seize Jun." "He had his officer Wang Luosheng take Jun by post-horse to Xiangguo, where he was beheaded in the market." Shi Le at this time in name served Han.

note: 概覽（約略）
概覽（約略） 慕容廆
noteEn: Murong Hui.

note: 「國等陷南鄭，盡徙漢中人於蜀。」（晉書·李雄載記）
noteEn: "Guo and the others took Nanzheng and moved all the people of Hanzhong to Shu."

note: 概覽（約略）
概覽（約略） 拓跋猗盧封代王
noteEn: Tuoba Yilu is made King of Dai.

note: 建興四年十一月愍帝出降（晉書·孝愍帝紀）
noteEn: In the eleventh month of the fourth year of Jianxing, Emperor Min comes out and surrenders.

note: 「勒先據險要，設伏以擊澹，大敗之，一軍皆沒」「琨窮蹙不能復守」（晉書·劉琨傳）
noteEn: "Le first seized the strong points, laid an ambush and struck Dan, routed him, and the whole army was lost." "Kun, driven to the wall, could hold out no longer."

note: 建武元年三月司馬睿即晉王位於建康（晉書·元帝紀）
noteEn: In the third month of the first year of Jianwu, Sima Rui takes the throne as King of Jin at Jiankang.

note: 概覽（約略） 張氏據涼州，仍奉晉正朔
noteEn: The Zhang family holds Liangzhou and still keeps the calendar of Jin.

note: 概覽（約略） 石勒稱趙王
noteEn: Shi Le takes the title King of Zhao.

note: 「由是黃河以南盡爲晉土。」（晉書·祖逖傳）所收郡縣範圍約略
noteEn: "From then all south of the Yellow River was the land of Jin."

note: 概覽（約略）
概覽（約略）
「季龍克上邽…秦、隴悉平。」（晉書·石勒載記下）
noteEn: "Jilong took Shanggui ... Qin and Long were all pacified."

note: 概覽（約略） 吐谷渾立國於青海
noteEn: The Tuyuhun found their state in Qinghai.

note: 概覽（約略）
概覽（約略） 段部亡
noteEn: The Duan are destroyed.

note: 「遼懼，棄令支，奔於密雲山。」（晉書·石季龍載記上）範圍約略
noteEn: "Liao, afraid, abandoned Lingzhi and fled to the Miyun hills."

note: 概覽（約略） 庾翼鎮襄陽
noteEn: Yu Yi commands at Xiangyang.

note: 概覽（約略） 桓溫滅成漢
noteEn: Huan Wen destroys Cheng-Han.

note: 「俊攻陷其城，斬他，因而都之。」（晉書·慕容儁載記）範圍約略
noteEn: "Jun attacked and took the city, beheaded Ta, and made it his capital."

note: 概覽（約略） 後趙南方守將降晉
noteEn: The Later Zhao commanders in the south go over to Jin.

note: 概覽（約略） 段龕據廣固，奉晉
noteEn: Duan Kan holds Guanggu and serves Jin.

note: 概覽（約略） 苻健入長安
noteEn: Fu Jian, founder of Former Qin, enters Chang'an.

note: 概覽（約略） 前燕取鄴
noteEn: Former Yan takes Ye.

note: 「溫屯故太極殿前，徙入金墉城，謁先帝諸陵」（晉書·桓溫傳）；「溫還軍之後，司、豫、青、兗復陷於賊」
noteEn: "Wen camped before the old Taiji Hall, moved into the Jinyong fortress, and paid his respects at the tombs of the former emperors." "After Wen took his army home, Si, Yu, Qing and Yan fell to the enemy again."

note: 「恪遂克廣固，以龕為伏順將軍」（晉書·慕容儁載記）範圍約略
noteEn: "Ke then took Guanggu and made Kan General Who Submits."

note: 「恪進兵入寇河南，汝、潁、譙、沛皆陷，置守宰而還。」（晉書·慕容儁載記）範圍約略
noteEn: "Ke advanced and raided south of the Yellow River; Ru, Ying, Qiao and Pei all fell, and he appointed governors and magistrates and went back."

note: 「尋為恪所攻，城陷，被執，神氣自若。」（晉書·沈勁傳）
noteEn: "Soon he was attacked by Ke; the city fell and he was taken, his bearing unchanged."

note: 概覽（約略） 前秦滅前燕
noteEn: Former Qin destroys Former Yan.

note: 概覽（約略）
概覽（約略） 前秦取梁、益
noteEn: Former Qin takes Liang and Yi provinces.

note: 「萇至姑臧，天錫乘素車白馬，面縛輿櫬，降於軍門。」（晉書·苻堅載記上）
noteEn: "Chang reached Guzang; Tianxi, in a plain carriage with white horses, his hands bound and his coffin carried behind, surrendered at the gate of the camp."

note: 「翼犍戰敗，遁于弱水」「其子翼圭縛父請降」（晉書·苻堅載記上）；《魏書·序紀》則記代王避於陰山之北，後至雲中而崩
noteEn: "Yijian was beaten in battle and fled to the Ruo River." "His son Yigui bound his father and asked to surrender." The preface of the Book of Wei instead has the King of Dai withdraw north of the Yin Mountains, then come to Yunzhong and die.

note: 「苻丕陷襄陽，執南中郎將硃序，送于長安」（晉書·苻堅載記上）
noteEn: "Fu Pi took Xiangyang, seized Zhu Xu, General of the Household of the South, and sent him to Chang'an."

note: 概覽（約略） 謝玄北伐
noteEn: Xie Xuan's northern campaign.

note: 概覽（約略）
概覽（約略）
「慕容沖入據長安，從兵大掠，死者不可勝計。」（晉書·苻堅載記下）
noteEn: "Murong Chong entered and held Chang'an; his troops plundered freely, and the dead were beyond counting."

note: 「九月，呂光據姑臧，自稱涼州刺史。」（晉書·孝武帝紀）
noteEn: "In the ninth month Lü Guang held Guzang and called himself inspector of Liangzhou."

note: 概覽（約略） 慕容垂建後燕於中山
noteEn: Murong Chui founds Later Yan at Zhongshan.

note: 概覽（約略）
概覽（約略） 姚萇入長安
noteEn: Yao Chang enters Chang'an.

note: 登國元年正月拓跋珪即代王位，二月幸定襄之盛樂（魏書·太祖紀）
noteEn: In the first month of the first year of Dengguo, Tuoba Gui takes the throne as King of Dai; in the second month he goes to Shengle in Dingxiang.

note: 概覽（約略）
概覽（約略）
「與興戰于山南，為興所敗，登被殺。」（晉書·苻登載記）
noteEn: "He fought Xing south of the mountain and was beaten by him, and Deng was killed."

note: 概覽（約略）
「大敗定，斬定及首虜萬七千級。於是盡有隴西、巴西之地。」（晉書·乞伏乾歸載記）範圍約略
noteEn: "He routed Ding and beheaded him, with seventeen thousand heads and prisoners. So he held all the land of Longxi and Baxi."

note: 「寶并州牧遼西王農大懼，將妻子棄城夜出，東遁，并州平。」（魏書·太祖紀）
noteEn: "Bao's governor of Bingzhou, Nong, King of Liaoxi, in great fear took his wife and children, left the city by night and fled east, and Bingzhou was pacified."

note: 「自常山以東，守宰或捐城奔竄，或稽顙軍門，唯中山、鄴、信都三城不下。」…「中山平。」（魏書·太祖紀）
noteEn: "East of Changshan the governors and magistrates either left their cities and fled or bowed their heads at the camp gate; only Zhongshan, Ye and Xindu did not fall." "Zhongshan was pacified."

note: 「曜兵廣武，攻克金城。光遣將軍竇苟來伐，戰於街亭，大敗之。降光樂都、湟河、澆河三郡」（晉書·禿髮烏孤載記）範圍約略
noteEn: "He paraded his troops at Guangwu and took Jincheng. Guang sent the general Dou Gou against him; they fought at Jieting and he routed him. He received the surrender of Guang's three commanderies of Ledu, Huanghe and Jiaohe."

note: 「屯據金山，與從兄男成推光建康太守段業為使持節、大都督、龍驤大將軍、涼州牧、建康公」（晉書·沮渠蒙遜載記）範圍約略
noteEn: "He camped on and held Jinshan, and with his cousin Nancheng put forward Duan Ye, Guang's governor of Jiankang, as commissioner with a staff, grand commander, Dragon-Soaring general-in-chief, governor of Liangzhou and Duke of Jiankang."

note: 「天興元年春正月，慕容德走保滑臺，儀克鄴，收其倉庫。」（魏書·太祖紀）
noteEn: "In spring of the first year of Tianxing, the first month, Murong De fled to hold Huatai; Yi took Ye and seized its granaries and stores."

note: 概覽（約略） 慕容德據廣固
noteEn: Murong De holds Guanggu.

note: 概覽（約略）
概覽（約略）
爨氏世據南中，名義上受東晉、南朝官爵（約略）
noteEn: The Cuan family holds Nanzhong for generations, in name taking office and rank from Eastern Jin and the Southern Dynasties.

note: 「旦而交戰，為興所敗。乾歸遁還苑川，遂走金城」（晉書·乞伏乾歸載記）「是月，姚興伐乞伏乾歸，降之。」（晉書·安帝紀）
noteEn: "At dawn they joined battle, and he was beaten by Xing. Gangui fled back to Yuanchuan and then to Jincheng." "In this month Yao Xing attacked Qifu Gangui and received his surrender."

note: 「社崘遠遁漠北，侵高車，深入其地，遂并諸部，凶勢益振。」「於是自號丘豆伐可汗。」（魏書·蠕蠕傳）範圍約略
noteEn: "Shelun fled far north of the desert, attacked the Gaoche, went deep into their land and absorbed their tribes, and his power grew more fearsome." "He then took the title Qiudoufa Khagan."

note: 「興乃遣其將齊難等步騎四萬迎之。」「隆率戶一萬，隨難東遷，至長安」（晉書·呂隆載記）
noteEn: "Xing then sent his general Qi Nan and others with forty thousand foot and horse to receive him." "Long led ten thousand households east with Nan to Chang'an."

note: 概覽（約略）
概覽（約略） 譙縱據蜀
noteEn: Qiao Zong holds Shu.

note: 「興乃署傉檀為使持節、都督河右諸軍事、車騎大將軍、領護匈奴中郎將、涼州刺史，常侍、公如故，鎮姑臧。」（晉書·禿髮傉檀載記）
noteEn: "Xing then appointed Rutan commissioner with a staff, commander of all forces west of the River, General of Chariots and Cavalry, Colonel Protecting the Xiongnu and inspector of Liangzhou, keeping his rank as attendant and duke, to hold Guzang."

note: 概覽（約略） 赫連勃勃稱天王
noteEn: Helian Bobo takes the title Heavenly King.

note: 概覽（約略）
「秋七月，姚興將乞伏乾歸僭稱西秦王于苑川。」（晉書·安帝紀）範圍約略
noteEn: "In autumn, the seventh month, Yao Xing's general Qifu Gangui usurped the title King of Western Qin at Yuanchuan."

note: 劉裕克廣固，南燕亡（宋書·武帝紀上）
noteEn: Liu Yu takes Guanggu, and Southern Yan falls.

note: 「俄而蒙遜遷于姑臧，以義熙八年僭即河西王位」（晉書·沮渠蒙遜載記）
noteEn: "Soon Mengxun moved to Guzang, and in the eighth year of Yixi usurped the throne as King of Hexi."

note: 概覽（約略）
「熾磐乘虛來襲」「一旬而城潰。」（晉書·禿髮傉檀載記）「夏六月，乞伏熾盤帥師伐禿髮傉檀，滅之。」（晉書·安帝紀）範圍約略
noteEn: "Chipan came to raid while it lay empty." "In ten days the city fell." "In summer, the sixth month, Qifu Chipan led his army against Tufa Rutan and destroyed him."

note: 劉裕北伐，取洛陽（宋書·武帝紀中）
noteEn: Liu Yu campaigns north and takes Luoyang.

note: 義熙十三年八月王鎮惡克長安，生擒姚泓（宋書·武帝紀中）
noteEn: In the eighth month of the thirteenth year of Yixi, Wang Zhen'e takes Chang'an and captures Yao Hong alive.

note: 概覽（約略）
「義真大掠而東，至於灞上，百姓遂逐齡石，而迎勃勃入于長安。」（晉書·赫連勃勃載記）
noteEn: "Yizhen plundered freely and went east as far as Bashang; the people then drove out Lingshi and welcomed Bobo into Chang'an."

note: 永初元年六月劉裕即皇帝位（宋書·武帝紀下）
noteEn: In the sixth month of the first year of Yongchu, Liu Yu takes the throne as emperor.

note: 「三面起隄，以水灌城。」「蒙遜勒兵逆戰，屠其城。」（晉書·涼武昭王傳）
noteEn: "He raised dykes on three sides and flooded the city." "Mengxun drew up his troops and met them in battle, and put the city to the sword."

note: 魏取滑臺
noteEn: Wei takes Huatai.

note: 魏取虎牢、洛陽
noteEn: Wei takes Hulao and Luoyang.

note: 始光四年六月克統萬（魏書·世祖紀上）
noteEn: In the sixth month of the fourth year of Shiguang, Tongwan is taken.

note: 元嘉七年七月索虜碻磝、滑臺戍棄城走（宋書·文帝紀）
noteEn: In the seventh month of the seventh year of Yuanjia the Wei garrisons of Qiao'ao and Huatai abandon their walls and go.

note: 十月金墉城（洛陽）為魏所陷，十一月虎牢復陷（宋書·文帝紀）
noteEn: In the tenth month the Jinyong fortress at Luoyang falls to Wei; in the eleventh Hulao falls again.

note: 魏取關中
noteEn: Wei takes Guanzhong.

note: 滑臺陷，宋軍退回
noteEn: Huatai falls, and the army of Song withdraws.

note: 夏亡
noteEn: Xia falls.

note: 西秦亡後隴西以西歸屬不明
noteEn: After the fall of Western Qin, who held the land west of Longxi is unclear.

note: 魏滅北燕
noteEn: Wei destroys Northern Yan.

note: 太延五年九月沮渠牧犍面縛軍門（魏書·世祖紀上）
noteEn: In the ninth month of the fifth year of Taiyan, Juqu Mujian comes bound to the gate of the camp.

note: 天安元年九月常珍奇以懸瓠、薛安都以彭城內屬（魏書·顯祖紀）
noteEn: In the ninth month of the first year of Tian'an, Chang Zhenqi brings Xuanhu over to Wei, and Xue Andu brings Pengcheng.

note: 魏取歷城
noteEn: Wei takes Licheng.

note: 東陽陷，宋失青州；於鬱洲僑立青州（宋書·州郡志二）
noteEn: Dongyang falls and Song loses Qingzhou; a Qingzhou in exile is set up on Yuzhou island.

note: 朐山、鬱洲仍屬宋
noteEn: Qushan and Yuzhou still belong to Song.

note: 概覽（約略） 高句麗陷百濟漢城
noteEn: Goguryeo takes Hanseong, the capital of Baekje.

note: 概覽（約略）
建元元年四月蕭道成即位
noteEn: In the fourth month of the first year of Jianyuan, Xiao Daocheng takes the throne.

note: 魏孝文帝取沔北五郡
noteEn: Emperor Xiaowen of Wei takes the five commanderies north of the Mian.

note: 景明元年正月裴叔業以壽春內屬（魏書·世宗紀）
noteEn: In the first month of the first year of Jingming, Pei Shuye brings Shouchun over to Wei.

note: 天監元年四月蕭衍即皇帝位（梁書·武帝紀中）
noteEn: In the fourth month of the first year of Tianjian, Xiao Yan takes the throne as emperor.

note: 魏取義陽（司州）
noteEn: Wei takes Yiyang, the seat of Sizhou.

note: 「閏月癸卯朔，蕭衍行梁州事夏侯道遷據漢中來降，假尚書邢巒鎮西將軍，率眾以赴之。」（魏書·世宗紀）
noteEn: "On the first day of the intercalary month, guimao, Xiahou Daoqian, Xiao Yan's acting governor of Liangzhou, came over with Hanzhong; the minister Xing Luan was given the rank of General Who Guards the West and led a force to him."

note: 韋叡克合肥（梁書·韋叡傳）
noteEn: Wei Rui takes Hefei.

note: 魏滅仇池（武興）
noteEn: Wei destroys Chouchi, the state at Wuxing.

note: 「三月，沃野鎮人破落汗拔陵聚眾反，殺鎮將，號真王元年。」（魏書·肅宗紀）範圍約略
noteEn: "In the third month Poliuhan Baling, a man of the Woye garrison, gathered a following and rebelled, killed the garrison commander, and proclaimed the first year of Zhenwang."

note: 「六月，秦州城人莫折太提據城反，自稱秦王，殺刺史李彥。」「太提遣城人卜朝襲克高平」（魏書·肅宗紀）範圍約略
noteEn: "In the sixth month Mozhe Taiti, a man of the city of Qinzhou, seized it and rebelled, called himself King of Qin, and killed the inspector Li Yan." "Taiti sent Bu Chao, a man of the city, to surprise and take Gaoping."

note: 「是月，破落汗拔陵別帥王也不盧等攻陷懷朔鎮。」（魏書·肅宗紀）範圍約略
noteEn: "In this month Wang Yebulu and other commanders under Poliuhan Baling attacked and took the Huaishuo garrison."

note: 「蠕蠕主阿那瓌率眾大破拔陵，斬其將孔雀等。」（魏書·肅宗紀）其後北鎮歸屬不明
noteEn: "Anagui, lord of the Rouran, led his host and routed Baling, beheading his officer Kongque and others." Who held the northern garrisons afterwards is unclear.

note: 「柔玄鎮人杜洛周率眾反於上谷，號年真王，攻沒郡縣，南圍燕州。」（魏書·肅宗紀）範圍約略
noteEn: "Du Luozhou, a man of the Rouxuan garrison, rebelled with his following at Shanggu, named his era Zhenwang, overran commanderies and counties, and to the south besieged Yanzhou."

note: 「衍將元樹逼壽春，揚州刺史李憲力屈，以城降之。」（魏書·肅宗紀）範圍約略
noteEn: "Yuan Shu, a general of Yan, pressed Shouchun; Li Xian, inspector of Yangzhou, his strength spent, surrendered the city to him."

note: 「冬十有一月戊戌，杜洛周攻陷幽州，執刺史王延年及行臺常景。」（魏書·肅宗紀）範圍約略
noteEn: "In winter, the eleventh month, on the day wuxu, Du Luozhou attacked and took Youzhou and seized the inspector Wang Yannian and the field commissioner Chang Jing."

note: 「辛巳，葛榮陷殷州，刺史崔楷固節死之，遂東圍冀州。」（魏書·肅宗紀）範圍約略
noteEn: "On the day xinsi Ge Rong took Yinzhou; the inspector Cui Kai held to his duty and died there, and Ge Rong went east and besieged Jizhou."

note: 「蕭寶夤、元恒芝大敗于涇州」「高平虜賊逼岐州，城人執刺史魏蘭根，以城應之。」（魏書·肅宗紀）範圍約略
noteEn: "Xiao Baoyin and Yuan Hengzhi were routed at Jingzhou." "The rebels of Gaoping pressed Qizhou; the men of the city seized the inspector Wei Langen and went over with the city."

note: 「甲寅，雍州刺史蕭寶夤據州反，自號曰齊，年稱隆緒。」（魏書·肅宗紀）
noteEn: "On the day jiayin Xiao Baoyin, inspector of Yongzhou, seized the province and rebelled, called his state Qi and his era Longxu."

note: 「十有一月己丑，葛榮攻陷冀州，執刺史元孚，逐出居民，凍死者十六七。」（魏書·肅宗紀）範圍約略
noteEn: "In the eleventh month, on the day jichou, Ge Rong attacked and took Jizhou, seized the inspector Yuan Fu, and drove out the inhabitants; six or seven in ten froze to death."

note: 「秦州城民杜粲殺莫折念生，自行州事。」「是月，杜粲為駱超所殺，超遣使歸罪。」（魏書·肅宗紀）
noteEn: "Du Can, a man of the city of Qinzhou, killed Mozhe Niansheng and took charge of the province himself." "In this month Du Can was killed by Luo Chao, who sent envoys to submit."

note: 「乙丑，定州為杜洛周所陷，執刺史楊津。瀛州刺史元寧以城降於洛周。」（魏書·肅宗紀）範圍約略
noteEn: "On the day yichou Dingzhou fell to Du Luozhou, who seized the inspector Yang Jin. Yuan Ning, inspector of Yingzhou, surrendered his city to Luozhou."

note: 「丁丑，雍州城人侯終德相率攻寶夤，寶夤攜南陽公主及子，與百餘騎渡渭而走，雍州平。」（魏書·肅宗紀）
noteEn: "On the day dingchou Hou Zhongde and other men of the city of Yongzhou together attacked Baoyin; Baoyin, with the Princess of Nanyang and his sons and a hundred or so riders, crossed the Wei and fled, and Yongzhou was pacified."

note: 「是月，杜洛周為葛榮所并。」（魏書·肅宗紀）
noteEn: "In this month Du Luozhou was absorbed by Ge Rong."

note: 「三月癸未，葛榮攻陷滄州，執刺史薛慶之，居民死者十八九。」（魏書·肅宗紀）範圍約略
noteEn: "In the third month, on the day guiwei, Ge Rong attacked and took Cangzhou and seized the inspector Xue Qingzhi; eight or nine in ten of the inhabitants died."

note: 「幽州平北府主簿河間邢杲，率河北流民十餘萬戶反於青州之北海，自署漢王，號年天統。」（魏書·孝莊紀）範圍約略
noteEn: "Xing Gao of Hejian, a clerk of the northern command in Youzhou, led more than a hundred thousand households of refugees from north of the River and rebelled at Beihai in Qingzhou, styled himself King of Han and named his era Tiantong."

note: 「壬申，柱國大將軍尒朱榮率騎七萬討葛榮於滏口，破擒之，餘眾悉降。」（魏書·孝莊紀）
noteEn: "On the day renshen the Pillar of State and general-in-chief Erzhu Rong led seventy thousand horse against Ge Rong at Fukou, defeated and captured him, and the rest of his host all surrendered."

note: 「是歲，葛榮餘黨韓樓復據幽州反。」（魏書·孝莊紀）範圍約略
noteEn: "In this year Han Lou, of what was left of Ge Rong's following, again held Youzhou in revolt."

note: 「辛丑，上黨王天穆、齊獻武王大破邢杲於齊州之濟南，杲降，送京師，斬於都市。」（魏書·孝莊紀）
noteEn: "On the day xinchou Tianmu, King of Shangdang, and the Xianwu King of Qi routed Xing Gao at Jinan in Qizhou; Gao surrendered, was sent to the capital and beheaded in the market."

note: 「九月，大都督侯淵討韓樓於薊，破斬之。」（魏書·孝莊紀）
noteEn: "In the ninth month the grand commander Hou Yuan attacked Han Lou at Ji, defeated and beheaded him."

note: 「丁卯，雍州刺史尒朱天光討醜奴、蕭寶夤於安定，破擒之，囚送京師。」（魏書·孝莊紀）
noteEn: "On the day dingmao Erzhu Tianguang, inspector of Yongzhou, attacked Chounu and Xiao Baoyin at Anding, defeated and captured them, and sent them prisoners to the capital."

note: 「秋七月丙子，天光平水洛城，擒慶雲，坑其城民一萬七千。」（魏書·孝莊紀）「於是三秦、河、渭、瓜、涼、鄯善咸來款順。」（魏書·尒朱天光傳）
noteEn: "In autumn, the seventh month, on the day bingzi, Tianguang reduced the city of Shuiluo, captured Qingyun, and buried alive seventeen thousand of its people." "Then the three Qin, He, Wei, Gua, Liang and Shanshan all came to submit."

note: 永熙三年七月孝武帝西奔長安；十月元善見即位，遷鄴（魏書·出帝紀、孝靜紀）
noteEn: In the seventh month of the third year of Yongxi, Emperor Xiaowu flees west to Chang'an; in the tenth month Yuan Shanjian takes the throne and the capital moves to Ye.

note: 關隴歸宇文泰（西魏）
noteEn: Guanzhong and Long pass to Yuwen Tai (Western Wei).

note: 大統三年十月沙苑之戰後取河東（周書·文帝紀下）
noteEn: After the battle of Shayuan in the tenth month of the third year of Datong, Hedong is taken.

note: 「戊子，至弘農。」「庚寅，城潰，斬徽伯，虜其戰士八千。」（周書·文帝紀下）
noteEn: "On the day wuzi he reached Hongnong." "On the day gengyin the city fell; Huibo was beheaded and eight thousand of his fighting men taken."

note: 河橋之戰後，洛陽一帶成為東西魏反覆爭奪之地
noteEn: After the battle of Heqiao the country round Luoyang is fought over again and again by Eastern and Western Wei.

note: 李賁稱帝，國號萬春
noteEn: Li Ben takes the title of emperor and names his state Wanchun (Van Xuan).

note: 「賊众大潰，賁竄入屈獠洞中，屈獠斬賁，傳首京師。」（陳書·高祖紀上）
noteEn: "The rebel host broke; Ben fled into the caves of the Qulao, and the Qulao beheaded him and sent his head to the capital."

note: 太清元年二月侯景以河南十三州內屬（梁書·武帝紀下）
noteEn: In the second month of the first year of Taiqing, Hou Jing brings the thirteen provinces south of the Yellow River over to Liang.

note: 「於是遣開府王思政據潁川，弼引軍還。」（周書·文帝紀下）
noteEn: "Then Wang Sizheng was sent to hold Yingchuan, and Bi led the army home."

note: 侯景敗於渦陽（梁書·侯景傳）
noteEn: Hou Jing is defeated at Guoyang.

note: 太清三年三月侯景陷臺城（梁書·元帝紀）
noteEn: In the third month of the third year of Taiqing, Hou Jing takes the palace city.

note: 「十二月，宋子仙、趙伯超、劉神茂進攻會稽，東揚州刺史臨成公大連棄城走」（梁書·侯景傳）範圍約略
noteEn: "In the twelfth month Song Zixian, Zhao Bochao and Liu Shenmao advanced on Kuaiji, and Dalian, Duke of Lincheng and inspector of East Yangzhou, abandoned the city and fled."

note: 東魏乘亂取淮南
noteEn: Eastern Wei uses the turmoil to take the land south of the Huai.

note: 「高岳起堰，引洧水以灌城」「夏六月，潁川陷。」（周書·文帝紀下）
noteEn: "Gao Yue raised a dam and led the Wei River to flood the city." "In summer, the sixth month, Yingchuan fell."

note: 天保元年五月高洋受禪
noteEn: In the fifth month of the first year of Tianbao, Gao Yang receives the abdication.

note: 北齊取廣陵
noteEn: Northern Qi takes Guangling.

note: 蕭詧附西魏，據襄陽
noteEn: Xiao Cha attaches himself to Western Wei and holds Xiangyang.

note: 交州豪強自立，南朝控制存疑
noteEn: The strongmen of Jiaozhou set up for themselves; whether the southern court held it is doubtful.

note: 王僧辯、陳霸先克建康，侯景敗死
noteEn: Wang Sengbian and Chen Baxian take Jiankang; Hou Jing is beaten and killed.

note: 概覽（約略） 突厥代柔然
noteEn: The Türks take the place of the Rouran.

note: 大統十九年八月尉遲迥克成都，劍南平（周書·文帝紀下）
noteEn: In the eighth month of the nineteenth year of Datong, Yuchi Jiong takes Chengdu, and the land south of Jiange is pacified.

note: 概覽（約略） 新羅取漢江流域
noteEn: Silla takes the valley of the Han River.

note: 江陵陷後，西魏立蕭詧於江陵
noteEn: After Jiangling falls, Western Wei sets up Xiao Cha there.

note: 蕭詧以襄陽入西魏
noteEn: Xiao Cha gives Xiangyang to Western Wei.

note: 北周代西魏
noteEn: Northern Zhou takes the place of Western Wei.

note: 永定元年十月陳霸先即皇帝位（陳書·高祖紀下）
noteEn: In the tenth month of the first year of Yongding, Chen Baxian takes the throne as emperor.

note: 王琳據湘、郢，奉北齊
noteEn: Wang Lin holds Xiang and Ying provinces and serves Northern Qi.

note: 「琳軍大敗。」「乃與妻妾左右十餘人入齊。」（陳書·侯瑱傳）
noteEn: "Lin's army was routed." "He then went over to Qi with his wives and some ten followers."

note: 「於是躬擐甲冑，四面疾攻，城中震恐，一鼓而克，生禽王琳、王貴顯」（陳書·吳明徹傳）範圍約略
noteEn: "He then put on armour himself and attacked hard on all four sides; the city was struck with fear and fell at the first drum, and Wang Lin and Wang Guixian were taken alive."

note: 「齊眾潰，遂克晉州」（周書·武帝紀下）
noteEn: "The host of Qi broke, and Jinzhou was taken."

note: 「至明，率諸軍更戰，大破之，擒延宗，幷州平。」（周書·武帝紀下）
noteEn: "At daybreak he led the armies to fight again, routed them and captured Yanzong, and Bingzhou was pacified."

note: 建德六年正月甲午周武帝入鄴（周書·武帝紀下）
noteEn: On the day jiawu of the first month of the sixth year of Jiande, Emperor Wu of Zhou enters Ye.

note: 北周盡有河洛
noteEn: Northern Zhou holds all the land of the Yellow River and the Luo.

note: 「是月，韋孝寬拔壽陽，𣏌國公亮拔黃城，梁士彥拔廣陵。陳人退走。於是江北盡平。」（周書·宣帝紀）
noteEn: "In this month Wei Xiaokuan took Shouyang, Liang, Duke of Qi, took Huangcheng, and Liang Shiyan took Guangling. The men of Chen withdrew. So all north of the Yangtze was pacified."

note: 「甲子，相州總管尉遲迥舉兵不受代。」（周書·靜帝紀）「迥所管相、衞、黎、毛、洺、貝、趙、冀、瀛、滄，勤所統青、膠、光、莒諸州，皆從之。」（周書·尉遲迥傳）範圍約略
noteEn: "On the day jiazi Yuchi Jiong, commander of Xiangzhou, raised troops and refused to be relieved." "Xiang, Wei, Li, Mao, Ming, Bei, Zhao, Ji, Ying and Cang under Jiong, and Qing, Jiao, Guang and Ju under Qin, all followed him."

note: 「庚午，韋孝寬破尉遲迥於鄴城，迥自殺，相州平。」（周書·靜帝紀）
noteEn: "On the day gengwu Wei Xiaokuan defeated Yuchi Jiong at Ye; Jiong killed himself, and Xiangzhou was pacified."

note: 「八月庚申，益州總管王謙舉兵不受代」（周書·靜帝紀）範圍約略
noteEn: "In the eighth month, on the day gengshen, Wang Qian, commander of Yizhou, raised troops and refused to be relieved."

note: 「戊寅，梁睿破王謙於劍南，追斬之，傳首京師。益州平。」（周書·靜帝紀）
noteEn: "On the day wuyin Liang Rui defeated Wang Qian south of Jiange, pursued and beheaded him, and sent his head to the capital. Yizhou was pacified."

note: 開皇元年二月楊堅受禪
noteEn: In the second month of the first year of Kaihuang, Yang Jian receives the abdication.

note: 概覽（約略） 突厥分東西
noteEn: The Türks divide into east and west.

note: 概覽（約略）
概覽（約略）
概覽（約略）
概覽（約略） 雅隆部（吐蕃前身）
noteEn: The Yarlung people, forerunners of the Tibetan empire.

note: 隋廢後梁
noteEn: Sui abolishes Later Liang.

note: 開皇九年正月韓擒虎入建康，獲陳主叔寶（隋書·高祖紀下）
noteEn: In the first month of the ninth year of Kaihuang, Han Qinhu enters Jiankang and takes Shubao, ruler of Chen.

note: 「癸丑，置西海、河源、鄯善、且末等四郡。」（隋書·煬帝紀上）範圍約略
noteEn: "On the day guichou the four commanderies of Xihai, Heyuan, Shanshan and Qiemo were set up."

note: 「十二月癸未，鄱陽賊操天成舉兵反，自號元興王，建元始興，攻陷豫章郡。」（隋書·煬帝紀下）
noteEn: "In the twelfth month, on the day guiwei, the Poyang rebel Cao Tiancheng raised troops and rebelled, called himself King Yuanxing, named his era Shixing, and took Yuzhang commandery."

note: 「鄱陽賊操天成舉兵反」（隋書·煬帝紀下）；鄱陽郡歸屬約略
noteEn: "The Poyang rebel Cao Tiancheng raised troops and rebelled." Who held Poyang commandery is approximate.

note: 「壬辰，鄱陽人林士弘自稱皇帝，國號楚，建元太平，攻陷九江、廬陵郡。」（隋書·煬帝紀下）隋九江郡治湓城，以柴桑、尋陽示之
noteEn: "On the day renchen Lin Shihong, a man of Poyang, called himself emperor, named his state Chu and his era Taiping, and took Jiujiang and Luling commanderies." The Sui commandery of Jiujiang had its seat at Pencheng, shown here by Chaisang and Xunyang.

note: 李淵「發自太原，有兵三萬」，「斬宋老生，平霍邑」，「十一月丙辰，攻拔京城」；河東城屈突通「自守不出」，未下（舊唐書·高祖紀）（弘農約略）
noteEn: Li Yuan "set out from Taiyuan with thirty thousand men", "beheaded Song Laosheng and reduced Huoyi", and "in the eleventh month, on the day bingchen, stormed the capital"; at the city of Hedong, Qutu Tong "held his walls and did not come out", and it did not fall. Hongnong is approximate.

note: 隋末羣雄蜂起，此處未能逐一錄其歸屬（約略）；有史文可據者另列
noteEn: At the end of Sui the strongmen rise like a swarm; who held what cannot be entered one by one here, and those the histories give words for have their own entries.

note: 「十三年春正月壬子，齊郡賊杜伏威率眾渡淮，攻陷歷陽郡。」（隋書·煬帝紀下）以鄰近的全椒示歷陽（約略）
noteEn: "In spring of the thirteenth year, the first month, on the day renzi, the Qi commandery rebel Du Fuwei led his host across the Huai and took Liyang commandery." Liyang is shown by Quanjiao nearby.

note: 「丙辰，勃海賊竇建德設壇於河間之樂壽，自稱長樂王，建元丁丑。」（隋書·煬帝紀下）
noteEn: "On the day bingchen the Bohai rebel Dou Jiande raised an altar at Leshou in Hejian, called himself King of Changle, and named his era Dingchou."

note: 「二月壬午，朔方人梁師都殺郡丞唐世宗，據郡反，自稱大丞相。」（隋書·煬帝紀下）隋朔方郡治統萬城故地
noteEn: "In the second month, on the day renwu, Liang Shidu, a man of Shuofang, killed the commandery's deputy Tang Shizong, seized the commandery and rebelled, and called himself grand chancellor." The Sui commandery of Shuofang had its seat on the site of Tongwan.

note: 「己丑，馬邑校尉劉武周殺太守王仁恭，舉兵作亂，北連突厥，自稱定楊可汗。」（隋書·煬帝紀下）雁門「以城降於武周」（舊唐書·劉武周傳）
noteEn: "On the day jichou Liu Wuzhou, a colonel of Mayi, killed the governor Wang Rengong, raised troops in revolt, joined with the Türks to the north, and called himself the Dingyang Khagan." Yanmen "surrendered its city to Wuzhou".

note: 「庚寅，賊帥李密、翟讓等陷興洛倉。」「庚子，李密自號魏公，稱元年」（隋書·煬帝紀下）
noteEn: "On the day gengyin the rebel leaders Li Mi, Zhai Rang and others took the Xingluo granary." "On the day gengzi Li Mi called himself Duke of Wei and proclaimed a first year."

note: 「河南諸郡相繼皆陷焉」（隋書·煬帝紀下）；何郡屬李密未詳（約略）
noteEn: "The commanderies south of the Yellow River fell one after another." Which of them were Li Mi's is not known.

note: 「夏四月癸未，金城校尉薛舉率眾反，自稱西秦霸王，建元秦興，攻陷隴右諸郡。」（隋書·煬帝紀下）
noteEn: "In summer, the fourth month, on the day guiwei, Xue Ju, a colonel of Jincheng, rebelled with his following, called himself Hegemon-King of Western Qin, named his era Qinxing, and took the commanderies of Longyou."

note: 「丙辰，武威人李軌舉兵反，攻陷河西諸郡，自稱涼王，建元安樂。」（隋書·煬帝紀下）
noteEn: "On the day bingchen Li Gui, a man of Wuwei, raised troops and rebelled, took the commanderies west of the River, called himself King of Liang, and named his era Anle."

note: 隋書言「攻陷河西諸郡」（隋書·煬帝紀下）；舊唐書則言其後「攻陷張掖、燉煌、西平、枹罕，盡有河西五郡之地」（舊唐書·李軌傳），時間有異（約略）
noteEn: The Book of Sui says he "took the commanderies west of the River"; the Old Book of Tang says that later he "took Zhangye, Dunhuang, Xiping and Fuhan and held all the land of the five commanderies west of the River". The two differ on the time.

note: 「是月，武陽郡丞元寶藏以郡叛歸李密，與賊帥李文相攻陷黎陽倉。」（隋書·煬帝紀下）
noteEn: "In this month Yuan Baozang, deputy of Wuyang commandery, went over to Li Mi with the commandery and, with the rebel leader Li Wenxiang, took the Liyang granary."

note: 「丙申，羅令蕭銑以縣反，鄱陽人董景珍以郡反，迎銑於羅縣，號為梁王，攻陷傍郡。」（隋書·煬帝紀下）
noteEn: "On the day bingshen Xiao Xian, magistrate of Luo, rebelled with his county, and Dong Jingzhen, a man of Poyang, with his commandery; they welcomed Xian at Luo county, styled him King of Liang, and took the neighbouring commanderies."

note: 「大業末，天下亂，伏允復其故地」（隋書·吐谷渾傳）年份約略
noteEn: "At the end of Daye, with the world in turmoil, Fuyun recovered his old land." The year is approximate.

note: 隋恭帝禪位，唐有天下之名；羣雄陸續平定（約略）
noteEn: Emperor Gong of Sui abdicates, and Tang has the name of ruling the world; the strongmen are put down one after another.

note: 「世充夜潛濟師，詰朝而陣，密方覺之，狼狽出戰，於是敗績」「元真竟以城降於世充」「密遂歸大唐」（隋書·李密傳）李密舊地與東都歸王世充（約略）
noteEn: "Shichong brought his army across in secret by night and at dawn stood in line; only then did Mi know, came out to fight in disorder, and was beaten." "Yuanzhen in the end surrendered the city to Shichong." "Mi then went over to the Great Tang." Li Mi's old land and the eastern capital pass to Wang Shichong.

note: 「劉武周聞金剛敗，大懼，棄并州走突厥」（資治通鑑·卷188） 唐平薛仁杲、李軌、劉武周（範圍約略）
noteEn: "Liu Wuzhou, hearing that Jingang was beaten, in great fear abandoned Bingzhou and fled to the Türks." Tang puts down Xue Rengao, Li Gui and Liu Wuzhou.

note: 「戊寅，王世充徐州行臺杞王世辯以徐、宋等三十八州詣河南道安撫大使任□襄請降；世充故地悉平」「乙巳，銑以太牢告於太廟，下令開門出降，守城者皆哭」（資治通鑑·卷189） 唐破竇建德、王世充、蕭銑（範圍約略）
noteEn: "On the day wuyin Shibian, King of Qi, Wang Shichong's field commissioner at Xuzhou, came with thirty-eight provinces, Xu, Song and the rest, to the pacification commissioner of Henan and asked to surrender; all Shichong's old land was pacified." "On the day yisi Xian announced it with a great sacrifice in the ancestral temple and ordered the gates opened for the surrender; the defenders all wept." Tang breaks Dou Jiande, Wang Shichong and Xiao Xian.

note: 「會士弘死，其眾遂散」（資治通鑑·卷190） 林士弘敗亡，江西諸郡入唐（範圍約略）
noteEn: "Just then Shihong died, and his following scattered." Lin Shihong is beaten and dies, and the commanderies of Jiangxi pass to Tang.

note: 「壬寅，師都從父弟洛仁殺師都，以城降，以其地為夏州」（資治通鑑·卷192） 唐滅梁師都（範圍約略）
noteEn: "On the day renyin Luoren, Shidu's cousin, killed Shidu and surrendered the city, and his land was made Xiazhou." Tang destroys Liang Shidu.

note: 李靖破突厥於陰山，頡利可汗遠遁（舊唐書·太宗紀下）
noteEn: Li Jing breaks the Türks at the Yin Mountains, and the Illig Khagan flees far away.

note: 概覽（約略） 伊吾內附，置伊州
noteEn: Yiwu submits, and Yizhou is set up.

note: 概覽（約略） 松贊干布都邏些
noteEn: Songtsen Gampo has his capital at Lhasa.

note: 「上不從，九月，以其地為西州，以可汗浮圖城為庭州，各置屬縣，乙卯，置安西都護府於交河城，留兵鎮之」（資治通鑑·卷195） 唐滅高昌，置西州、庭州（範圍約略）
noteEn: "The emperor would not listen. In the ninth month its land was made Xizhou and the town of Kehan Futu was made Tingzhou, each with its counties; on the day yimao the Anxi Protectorate was set up at the city of Jiaohe, with troops left to hold it." Tang destroys Gaochang and sets up Xizhou and Tingzhou.

note: 「薛延陀咄摩支南奔荒谷，世勣遣通事舍人蕭嗣業往招慰，咄摩支詣嗣業降」「丙寅，置燕然都護府，統瀚海等六都督、皋蘭等七州，以揚州都督府司馬李素立為之」（資治通鑑·卷198） 唐滅薛延陀，設燕然都護府（範圍約略）
noteEn: "Duomozhi of the Xueyantuo fled south into a desolate valley; Shiji sent the secretary Xiao Siye to win him over, and Duomozhi came to Siye and surrendered." "On the day bingyin the Yanran Protectorate was set up, over six area commands, Hanhai and the rest, and seven prefectures, Gaolan and the rest, with Li Suli, marshal of the Yangzhou command, at its head." Tang destroys the Xueyantuo and sets up the Yanran Protectorate.

note: 太宗破龜茲，移安西都護府於其國城，統于闐、疏勒、碎葉，謂之四鎮（舊唐書·西戎傳）
noteEn: Taizong breaks Qiuci (Kucha) and moves the Anxi Protectorate to its capital, over Yutian (Khotan), Shule (Kashgar) and Suiye (Suyab): the Four Garrisons.

note: 「定方至曳咥河西，沙缽羅帥十姓兵且十萬來拒戰」「阿史那賀魯既被擒，謂蕭嗣業曰：「我本亡虜，為先帝所存，先帝遇我厚而我負之，今日之敗，天所怒也」（資治通鑑·卷200） 蘇定方滅西突厥（賀魯被擒，《通鑑》繫於次年）（範圍約略）
noteEn: "Dingfang came west of the Yedie River, and Shaboluo with the troops of the ten tribes, near a hundred thousand, came to oppose him." "Ashina Helu, taken prisoner, said to Xiao Siye: I was a ruined fugitive whom the late emperor preserved; he treated me generously and I betrayed him; today's defeat is Heaven's anger." Su Dingfang destroys the Western Türks (the Tongjian puts Helu's capture in the next year).

note: 「於是義慈、隆及諸城主皆降」（資治通鑑·卷200） 唐滅百濟（範圍約略）
noteEn: "Then Uija, Yung and the lords of all the cities surrendered." Tang destroys Baekje.

note: 「吐谷渾之臣素和貴有罪，逃奔吐蕃，具言吐谷渾虛實，吐蕃發兵擊吐谷渾，大破之，吐谷渾可汗曷缽與弘化公主帥數千帳棄國走依涼州，請徙居內地」（資治通鑑·卷201） 吐蕃滅吐谷渾（範圍約略）
noteEn: "Suhe Gui, a minister of the Tuyuhun, had offended and fled to Tibet, where he told all the strengths and weaknesses of the Tuyuhun; Tibet sent an army and routed them, and the Tuyuhun khagan Hebo with the Honghua princess led a few thousand tents out of the country to Liangzhou and asked to be moved inside the empire." Tibet destroys the Tuyuhun.

note: 「泉男建流黔州，扶餘豐流嶺南，分高麗五部、百七十六城、六十九萬餘戶，為九都督府、四十二州、百縣，置安東都護府於平壤以統之」（資治通鑑·卷201） 唐滅高句麗，置安東都護府（範圍約略）
noteEn: "Yeon Namgeon was banished to Qianzhou and Buyeo Pung to Lingnan; the five divisions of Goguryeo, with a hundred and seventy-six cities and more than six hundred and ninety thousand households, were made nine area commands, forty-two prefectures and a hundred counties, and the Andong Protectorate was set up at Pyongyang over them." Tang destroys Goguryeo and sets up the Andong Protectorate.

note: 吐蕃大入，四鎮城堡並為所陷（舊唐書·西戎傳）
noteEn: Tibet invades in force, and the forts of the Four Garrisons all fall to it.

note: 「二月，甲戌，徙安東都護府於遼東故城；先是有華人任安東官者，悉罷之」（資治通鑑·卷202） 新羅統一大同江以南（範圍約略）
noteEn: "In the second month, on the day jiaxu, the Andong Protectorate was moved to the old city of Liaodong; the Chinese who had held office under it were all dismissed." Silla unites the land south of the Taedong River.

note: 「是歲，突厥餘黨阿史那骨篤祿、阿史德元珍等招集亡散，據黑沙城反，入寇并州及單于府之北境，殺嵐州刺史王德茂」（資治通鑑·卷203） 後突厥復國（範圍約略）
noteEn: "In this year Ashina Gudulu, Ashide Yuanzhen and others of what was left of the Türks gathered the scattered, seized the town of Heisha and rebelled, raided Bingzhou and the northern border of the Chanyu command, and killed Wang Demao, prefect of Lanzhou." The Second Türk Khaganate is restored.

note: 「冬，十月，丙戌，大破吐蕃，復取四鎮，置安西都護府於龜茲，發兵戍之」（資治通鑑·卷205） 王孝傑復四鎮（範圍約略）
noteEn: "In winter, the tenth month, on the day bingxu, Tibet was routed and the Four Garrisons retaken; the Anxi Protectorate was set up at Qiuci and troops sent to garrison it." Wang Xiaojie retakes the Four Garrisons.

note: 「及李盡忠反，祚榮與靺鞨乞四北羽聚眾東走，阻險自固」（資治通鑑·卷210） 大祚榮建國（渤海）；《通鑑》追敘於開元元年（範圍約略）
noteEn: "When Li Jinzhong rebelled, Zuorong with Qisi Biyu of the Mohe gathered a following and went east, and made themselves secure behind difficult ground." Dae Joyeong founds his state, Balhae; the Tongjian tells it in retrospect under the first year of Kaiyuan.

note: 「皮邏閣浸強大，而五詔微弱；會有破渳河蠻之功，乃賂王昱，求合六詔爲一」（資治通鑑·卷214） 皮邏閣統一六詔（範圍約略）
noteEn: "Piluoge grew steadily stronger while the five zhao were weak; having the merit of defeating the Man of the Er River, he bribed Wang Yu and asked to join the six zhao into one." Piluoge unites the six zhao.

note: 「回紇骨力裴羅自立為骨咄祿毘伽闕可汗，遣使言狀；上冊拜裴羅為懷仁可汗」「回紇懷仁可汗擊突厥白眉可汗，殺之，傳首京師」（資治通鑑·卷215） 回鶻滅後突厥（範圍約略）
noteEn: "Guli Peiluo of the Uyghurs made himself Qutlugh Bilge Kül Khagan and sent envoys to report it; the emperor appointed Peiluo the Huairen Khagan." "The Huairen Khagan of the Uyghurs attacked the Baimei Khagan of the Türks, killed him, and sent his head to the capital." The Uyghurs destroy the Second Türk Khaganate.

note: 概覽（約略） 渤海西拓（年代約略）
noteEn: Balhae expands westward (the date is approximate).

note: 「夏，四月，壬午，劍南節度使鮮于仲通討南詔蠻，大敗於瀘南」（資治通鑑·卷216） 南詔敗唐軍（範圍約略）
noteEn: "In summer, the fourth month, on the day renwu, Xianyu Zhongtong, military governor of Jiannan, attacked the Man of Nanzhao and was routed south of the Lu." Nanzhao defeats the army of Tang.

note: 安祿山陷長安；玄宗西奔，次馬嵬驛（舊唐書·玄宗紀下）
noteEn: An Lushan takes Chang'an; Xuanzong flees west and halts at the Mawei post station.

note: 「癸卯，大軍入西京」「壬戌，廣平王俶入東京」（資治通鑑·卷220） 唐收復兩京（範圍約略）
noteEn: "On the day guimao the main army entered the western capital." "On the day renxu Chu, Prince of Guangping, entered the eastern capital." Tang recovers the two capitals.

note: 「庚寅，思明入洛陽，城空，無所得，畏光弼掎其後，不敢入宮，退屯白馬寺南，築月城於河陽南以拒光弼」（資治通鑑·卷221） 史思明再陷洛陽（範圍約略）
noteEn: "On the day gengyin Siming entered Luoyang; the city was empty and he gained nothing. Fearing Guangbi at his rear, he did not dare enter the palace, but fell back to camp south of the White Horse Temple and built a crescent wall south of Heyang to hold Guangbi off." Shi Siming takes Luoyang again.

note: 「懷恩進克東京及河陽城，獲其中書令許叔冀、王胄等，制釋之」（資治通鑑·卷222） 唐軍收復東京（範圍約略）
noteEn: "Huai'en advanced and took the eastern capital and the city of Heyang, and captured their chief ministers Xu Shuji, Wang Zhou and others, whom an edict set free." The army of Tang recovers the eastern capital.

note: 「癸亥，以史朝義降將薛嵩為相、衛、邢、洺、貝、磁六州節度使，田承嗣為魏、博、德、滄、瀛五州都防禦使，李懷仙仍故地為幽州、盧龍節度使」（資治通鑑·卷222） 安史亂平，河朔三鎮名奉唐室（州目據所引文）
noteEn: "On the day guihai Shi Chaoyi's surrendered generals were appointed: Xue Song military governor of the six prefectures of Xiang, Wei, Xing, Ming, Bei and Ci; Tian Chengsi defence commissioner of the five prefectures of Wei, Bo, De, Cang and Ying; and Li Huaixian, in his old territory, military governor of Youzhou and Lulong." The rebellion of An and Shi is over, and the three commands north of the River serve Tang in name (the prefectures are those the passage lists).

note: 「丁酉，以張忠志為成德軍節度使，統恆、趙、深、定、易五州，賜姓李，名寶臣」（資治通鑑·卷222） 成德（李寶臣）；《通鑑》繫於寶應元年十一月（恆州後改鎮州）
noteEn: "On the day dingyou Zhang Zhongzhi was made military governor of the Chengde army, over the five prefectures of Heng, Zhao, Shen, Ding and Yi, and was granted the surname Li and the name Baochen." Chengde under Li Baochen; the Tongjian puts it in the eleventh month of the first year of Baoying (Hengzhou was later renamed Zhenzhou).

note: 「癸亥，以史朝義降將薛嵩為相、衛、邢、洺、貝、磁六州節度使，田承嗣為魏、博、德、滄、瀛五州都防禦使，李懷仙仍故地為幽州、盧龍節度使」（資治通鑑·卷222） （幽州所領州目，文中不列，據其故地，約略）
noteEn: "On the day guihai Shi Chaoyi's surrendered generals were appointed: Xue Song military governor of the six prefectures of Xiang, Wei, Xing, Ming, Bei and Ci; Tian Chengsi defence commissioner of the five prefectures of Wei, Bo, De, Cang and Ying; and Li Huaixian, in his old territory, military governor of Youzhou and Lulong." The prefectures under Youzhou are not listed in the passage; they follow its old territory, approximately.

note: 「吐蕃入大震關，陷蘭、廓、河、鄯、洮、岷、秦、成、渭等州，盡取河西、隴右之地」（資治通鑑·卷223） 吐蕃陷隴右諸州（州目據所引文）（廓州、洮州無州治之點，不另列）（廓州、洮州無州治之點，不另列）
noteEn: "Tibet came in through the Dazhen pass, took Lan, Kuo, He, Shan, Tao, Min, Qin, Cheng, Wei and other prefectures, and seized all the land of Hexi and Longyou." Tibet takes the prefectures of Longyou (those the passage lists; Kuozhou and Taozhou have no seat marked and are not shown).

note: 概覽（約略）
概覽（約略） 沙州陷
noteEn: Shazhou falls.

note: 「北庭人苦於回鶻誅求，與沙陀酋長朱邪盡忠皆降於吐蕃」（資治通鑑·卷233） 北庭陷（範圍約略）
noteEn: "The people of Beiting, worn down by the exactions of the Uyghurs, went over to Tibet together with the Shatuo chief Zhuye Jinzhong." Beiting falls.

note: 概覽（約略） 安西失陷（年代約略）
noteEn: Anxi is lost (the date is approximate).

note: 「及掘羅勿殺彰信可汗，立馺，回鶻別將句録莫賀引黠戛斯十萬騎攻回鶻，大破之，殺馺及掘羅勿，焚其牙帳蕩盡，回鶻諸部逃散」（資治通鑑·卷246） 黠戛斯破回鶻，漠北無主（範圍約略）
noteEn: "When Jueluowu killed the Zhangxin Khagan and set up Sa, the Uyghur commander Julu Mohe brought a hundred thousand Kirghiz horse against the Uyghurs and routed them, killed Sa and Jueluowu and burned their court to the ground, and the Uyghur tribes scattered." The Kirghiz break the Uyghurs, and the land north of the desert has no master.

note: 「義潮，沙州人也，時吐蕃大亂，義潮陰結豪傑，謀自拔歸唐」（資治通鑑·卷249） 張議潮逐吐蕃，歸唐（《通鑑》作「義潮」，其來降繫於大中五年二月；起事之年不載）（範圍約略）
noteEn: "Yichao was a man of Shazhou. Tibet was then in great disorder, and Yichao secretly bound the leading men to him and planned to break free and return to Tang." Zhang Yichao drives out the Tibetans and returns to Tang (the Tongjian puts his submission in the second month of the fifth year of Dazhong and does not give the year he rose).

note: 概覽（約略） 吐蕃王朝崩解 （河隴之地，只及吐蕃當時所據者）
noteEn: The Tibetan empire breaks up (of Hexi and Longyou, only what Tibet then held is shown).

note: 「吐蕃秦、原、安樂三州及石門等七關來降」（資治通鑑·卷248） 唐收秦州（州目據所引文）
noteEn: "The three Tibetan-held prefectures of Qin, Yuan and Anle and the seven passes, Shimen and the rest, came over." Tang recovers Qinzhou (the prefectures are those the passage lists).

note: 「春，二月，歸義節度使張義潮奏北庭回鶻固俊克西州、北庭、輪台、清鎮等城」（資治通鑑·卷250） 西州回鶻（《通鑑》作「固俊」）（範圍約略）
noteEn: "In spring, the second month, Zhang Yichao, military governor of Guiyi, reported that Gujun of the Beiting Uyghurs had taken Xizhou, Beiting, Luntai, Qingzhen and other towns." The Uyghurs of Xizhou (Gujun is the Tongjian's spelling of the name).

note: 概覽（約略） 于闐李氏
noteEn: The Li family of Khotan.

note: 概覽（約略）
黃巢陷京師，僖宗出奔（舊唐書·黃巢傳）
noteEn: Huang Chao takes the capital, and Xizong flees.

note: 「甲辰，克用等自光泰門入京師，黃巢力戰不勝，焚宮室遁去」（資治通鑑·卷255） 唐軍收復長安（範圍約略）
noteEn: "On the day jiachen Keyong and the others entered the capital by the Guangtai gate; Huang Chao fought hard and could not win, burned the palaces and fled." The army of Tang recovers Chang'an.

note: 朱溫據宣武，兼河南諸鎮（約略）
noteEn: Zhu Wen holds Xuanwu and adds to it the commands south of the Yellow River.

note: 概覽（約略） 李克用據河東
noteEn: Li Keyong holds Hedong.

note: 概覽（約略） 楊行密據淮南
noteEn: Yang Xingmi holds Huainan.

note: 概覽（約略） 錢鏐據兩浙
noteEn: Qian Liu holds the two Zhe.

note: 概覽（約略） 馬殷據湖南
noteEn: Ma Yin holds Hunan.

note: 概覽（約略） 王審知據福建
noteEn: Wang Shenzhi holds Fujian.

note: 概覽（約略） 王建據兩川
noteEn: Wang Jian holds the two Chuan.

note: 「為清海節度使劉隱同平章事」（資治通鑑·卷265） 劉隱據嶺南（範圍約略）
noteEn: "Liu Yin, military governor of Qinghai, was given the rank of chief minister." Liu Yin holds Lingnan.

note: 「秦裴拔洪州，虜鍾匡時等五千人以歸」（資治通鑑·卷265） 吳取江西（範圍約略）
noteEn: "Qin Pei took Hongzhou and carried off Zhong Kuangshi and five thousand others." Wu takes Jiangxi.

note: 「乙丑，加靜海節度使曲承裕同平章事」（資治通鑑·卷265） 曲氏自立於交州（範圍約略）
noteEn: "On the day yichou Qu Chengyu, military governor of Jinghai, was given the rank of chief minister." The Qu (Khuc) family sets up for itself in Jiaozhou.

note: 天祐四年四月，朱全忠即皇帝位，唐亡（舊五代史·梁太祖紀）
