noteEn: In the fourth month of the fourth year of Tianyou, Zhu Quanzhong takes the throne as emperor, and Tang ends.

note: 「及阿保機為王，尤雄勇，五姓奚及七姓室韋、達靼咸役屬之」（資治通鑑·卷266） 耶律阿保機即可汗位（範圍約略）
noteEn: "When Abaoji became king he was bolder and stronger still; the five clans of the Xi and the seven clans of the Shiwei and the Tatars were all made his subjects." Yelü Abaoji takes the place of khagan.

note: 「壬戌，晉王督諸軍四面攻城，克之，擒劉仁恭及其妻妾，守光帥妻子亡去」（資治通鑑·卷268） 晉滅燕（劉守光） （幽、涿、檀、薊、順、營、平、媯諸州，並燕所餘之地）
noteEn: "On the day renxu the King of Jin drove his armies against the city from all four sides and took it, capturing Liu Rengong with his wives; Shouguang fled with his wife and children." Jin destroys the Yan of Liu Shouguang: the prefectures of You, Zhuo, Tan, Ji, Shun, Ying, Ping and Gui, and what else Yan still held.

note: 「晉王得賀德倫書，命馬步副總管李存審自趙州引兵進據臨清」（資治通鑑·卷269） 魏博歸晉 魏、博、貝、衞、澶入晉（據《職方考》表）
noteEn: "The King of Jin, receiving He Delun's letter, ordered Li Cunshen, deputy commander of horse and foot, to lead troops from Zhaozhou and occupy Linqing." Weibo goes over to Jin: Wei, Bo, Bei, Wey and Chan pass to Jin (from the table of the Treatise on the Prefectures).

note: 「契丹王阿保機自稱皇帝，國人謂之天皇王，以妻述律氏為皇后，置百官」（資治通鑑·卷269） 阿保機稱帝（範圍約略）
noteEn: "Abaoji, King of the Khitan, called himself emperor; his people called him the Heavenly August King. He made his wife, of the Shulü clan, empress, and appointed the hundred officials." Abaoji takes the title of emperor.

note: 概覽（約略） 王建建高麗
noteEn: Wang Geon founds Goryeo.

note: 「丙午夜，城中將李再豐為內應，密投縋以納晉兵，比明畢登，執處瑾兄弟家人及其黨高濛、李翥、齊儉送行台，趙人皆請而食之，磔張文禮屍於市」（資治通鑑·卷271） 晉取鎮州 晉取鎮、冀、深、趙；易、祁、定（義武）亦附晉（據《職方考》表）
noteEn: "On the night of the day bingwu Li Zaifeng, an officer in the city, worked from inside and let down ropes in secret to bring in the troops of Jin; by dawn all had climbed up. They seized Chujin, his brothers and household, with his partisans Gao Meng, Li Zhu and Qi Jian, and sent them to the field headquarters; the men of Zhao all asked for them and ate their flesh, and the corpse of Zhang Wenli was dismembered in the market." Jin takes Zhenzhou: Zhen, Ji, Shen and Zhao; Yi, Qi and Ding, the Yiwu command, also attach themselves to Jin (from the table of the Treatise on the Prefectures).

note: 「是日，帝入自梁門，百官迎謁於馬首，拜伏請罪，帝慰勞之，使各復其位」（資治通鑑·卷272） 後唐滅梁（範圍約略）
noteEn: "On this day the emperor entered by the Liang gate; the hundred officials met him at his horse's head, bowed to the ground and asked for punishment. The emperor comforted them and had each return to his post." Later Tang destroys Liang.

note: 概覽（約略）
概覽（約略） 契丹西征漠北
noteEn: The Khitan campaign west, north of the desert.

note: 「丙午，加高季興兼尚書令，時封南平王」（資治通鑑·卷273） 高季興受封南平王 （州目據《職方考》表：荊）
noteEn: "On the day bingwu Gao Jixing was given the added office of director of the Department of State Affairs, and at this time was made King of Nanping." Gao Jixing is made King of Nanping (his one prefecture, by the table of the Treatise on the Prefectures, is Jing).

note: 「丙辰，李嚴引蜀主及百官儀衛出降於陞遷橋，蜀主白衣、銜璧、牽羊，草繩縈首，百官衰絰、徒跣、輿櫬，號哭俟命」（資治通鑑·卷274） 後唐滅前蜀（範圍約略）
noteEn: "On the day bingchen Li Yan led the ruler of Shu and his officials and guard out to surrender at the Shengqian bridge: the ruler in white, a jade disc in his mouth, leading a sheep, a rope of straw round his head; the officials in mourning, barefoot, with coffins carried behind, wailing and awaiting orders." Later Tang destroys Former Shu.

note: 「契丹主攻勃海，拔其夫餘城，更命曰東丹國」（資治通鑑·卷275） 契丹滅渤海（《通鑑》作「勃海」，追記於是年七月）（範圍約略）
noteEn: "The Khitan ruler attacked Bohai, took its city of Fuyu, and renamed the country Dongdan." The Khitan destroy Balhae (the Tongjian records it in retrospect in the seventh month of this year).

note: 「己巳，知祥即皇帝位於成都」（資治通鑑·卷278） 孟知祥稱帝，後蜀（州目據《職方考》表；兩川境內表所不列之羈縻州並入）
noteEn: "On the day jisi Zhixiang took the throne as emperor at Chengdu." Meng Zhixiang takes the title of emperor: Later Shu (the prefectures follow the table of the Treatise on the Prefectures; the loose-rein prefectures within the two Chuan that the table does not list are included).

note: 概覽（約略） 新羅降高麗
noteEn: Silla surrenders to Goryeo.

note: 「辛巳，唐主與曹太后、劉皇后、雍王重美及宋審虔等攜傳國寶登玄武樓自焚，皇后積薪欲燒宮室，重美諫曰：「新天子至，必不露居，他日重勞民力；死而遺怨，將安用之」（資治通鑑·卷280） 石敬瑭借契丹兵滅後唐（範圍約略）
noteEn: "On the day xinsi the ruler of Tang, with the Empress Dowager Cao, the Empress Liu, Chongmei, Prince of Yong, Song Shenqian and others, took the seal of state up the Xuanwu tower and burned themselves to death. The empress had piled firewood to burn the palaces; Chongmei objected: when the new Son of Heaven comes he will not live in the open, and the people will be put to the labour again; to die and leave a grievance, what use is that?" Shi Jingtang, with Khitan troops, destroys Later Tang.

note: 「冬，十月，甲申，齊王誥即皇帝位於金陵，大赦，改元升元，國號唐」（資治通鑑·卷281） 李昪代吳，南唐（範圍約略）
noteEn: "In winter, the tenth month, on the day jiashen, Gao, King of Qi, took the throne as emperor at Jinling, proclaimed an amnesty, named the era Shengyuan and the state Tang." Li Bian takes the place of Wu: Southern Tang.

note: 概覽（約略） 段思平建大理
noteEn: Duan Siping founds Dali.

note: 晉獻幽、薊、瀛、莫、涿、檀、順、媯、儒、新、武、雲、應、朔、寰、蔚十六州（遼史·太宗紀下）（儒州、應州、寰州無州治之點，不另列） （燕、威、玄、崇、師、鮮、帶、黎、瑞、信十州為幽州界內羈縻僑治，隨幽州）（儒州、新州、武州、應州、寰州無州治之點，不另列）
noteEn: Jin cedes the sixteen prefectures: You, Ji, Ying, Mo, Zhuo, Tan, Shun, Gui, Ru, Xin, Wu, Yun, Ying, Shuo, Huan and Yu. Ruzhou, Xinzhou, Wuzhou, Yingzhou and Huanzhou have no seat marked and are not shown; the ten loose-rein prefectures lodged within Youzhou go with Youzhou.

note: 「楊延藝故將吳權自愛州舉兵攻皎公羨於交州，公羨遣使以賂求救於漢」（資治通鑑·卷281） 吳權敗南漢，交州自立（白藤江之役，《通鑑》繫於前一年十月）（範圍約略）
noteEn: "Wu Quan, a former officer of Yang Yanyi, raised troops from Aizhou and attacked Jiao Gongxian at Jiaozhou; Gongxian sent envoys with gifts to ask help of Han." Wu Quan (Ngo Quyen) defeats Southern Han, and Jiaozhou stands by itself (the Tongjian puts the battle of the Bach Dang River in the tenth month of the year before).

note: 「丁亥，唐先鋒橋道使上元王建封先登，遂克建州，閩主延政降」（資治通鑑·卷285） 南唐滅閩（福州入吳越） 建、汀、漳、泉入南唐，南唐置劍州（據《職方考》表）
noteEn: "On the day dinghai Wang Jianfeng of Shangyuan, the Tang commissioner of the vanguard for bridges and roads, was first up the wall, and so Jianzhou was taken and Yanzheng, ruler of Min, surrendered." Southern Tang destroys Min, and Fuzhou passes to Wuyue: Jian, Ting, Zhang and Quan pass to Southern Tang, which sets up a new prefecture, the "Sword" Jianzhou (from the table of the Treatise on the Prefectures).

note: 「是日，契丹主自赤岡引兵入宮，都城諸門及宮禁門，皆以契丹守衛，晝夜不釋兵仗」「辛未，劉知遠即皇帝位」（資治通鑑·卷286） 契丹滅晉，劉知遠建後漢（範圍約略）
noteEn: "On this day the Khitan ruler led his troops from Chigang into the palace; the gates of the capital and of the palace were all guarded by Khitan, who did not lay down their arms day or night." "On the day xinwei Liu Zhiyuan took the throne as emperor." The Khitan destroy Jin, and Liu Zhiyuan founds Later Han.

note: 「春正月，丁卯，漢太后下誥，授監國符寶，即皇帝位」（資治通鑑·卷290） 郭威代漢（範圍約略）
noteEn: "In spring, the first month, on the day dingmao, the Empress Dowager of Han issued a decree handing the tallies and seals to the regent, and he took the throne as emperor." Guo Wei takes the place of Han.

note: 「是日，劉崇即皇帝位於晉陽，仍用乾祐年號，所有者并、汾、忻、代、嵐、憲、隆、蔚、沁、遼、麟、石十二州之地」（資治通鑑·卷290） 劉崇據太原，北漢 （蔚州已入契丹，圖不從）（太原府、憲州、隆州、麟州無州治之點，不另列）（憲州、隆州、麟州無州治之點，不另列）（隆州無州治之點，不另列）
noteEn: "On this day Liu Chong took the throne as emperor at Jinyang, still using the Qianyou era; what he held was the land of twelve prefectures: Bing, Fen, Xin, Dai, Lan, Xian, Long, Yu, Qin, Liao, Lin and Shi." Liu Chong holds Taiyuan: Northern Han. Yuzhou had already passed to the Khitan, and there the map does not follow the passage; Taiyuan, Xianzhou, Longzhou and Linzhou have no seat marked and are not shown.

note: 「癸卯，希崇帥弟侄迎鎬，望塵而拜，鎬下馬稱詔勞之」（資治通鑑·卷290） 南唐滅楚（旋為周行逢所據） 潭、衡、澧、朗、岳、道、永、邵、辰諸州（據《職方考》表）
noteEn: "On the day guimao Xichong led his brothers and nephews to meet Hao and bowed at the sight of his dust; Hao dismounted and greeted them in the emperor's name." Southern Tang destroys Chu, which soon falls to Zhou Xingfeng: the prefectures of Tan, Heng, Li, Lang, Yue, Dao, Yong, Shao and Chen (from the table of the Treatise on the Prefectures).

note: 「於是江北悉平，得州十四，縣六十」（資治通鑑·卷294） 後周取南唐江北十四州 揚、楚、泗、滁、和、光、黃、舒、蘄、廬、壽、海、泰、濠（據《職方考》表）
noteEn: "So all north of the Yangtze was pacified: fourteen prefectures and sixty counties were gained." Later Zhou takes Southern Tang's fourteen prefectures north of the Yangtze: Yang, Chu, Si, the Chuzhou on the Chu River, He, Guang, Huang, Shu, Qi, Lu, Shou, Hai, Tai and Hao (from the table of the Treatise on the Prefectures).

note: 「甲辰，契丹莫州刺史劉楚信舉城降」（資治通鑑·卷294） 周世宗取瀛、莫（瀛州刺史高彥暉之降在其後，五月乙巳朔）（州目據所引文） （益津、瓦橋、淤口三關之地，即後之霸州、雄州、信安軍）
noteEn: "On the day jiachen Liu Chuxin, the Khitan prefect of Mozhou, surrendered his city." Emperor Shizong of Zhou takes Ying and Mo (Gao Yanhui, prefect of Yingzhou, surrendered after this, on the first day of the fifth month), with the land of the three passes of Yijin, Waqiao and Yukou, later Bazhou, Xiongzhou and the Xin'an command.

note: 陳橋兵變，「有以黃衣加太祖身」，宋代周（宋史·太祖紀一）
noteEn: The mutiny at Chenqiao: "someone put a yellow robe on Taizu"; Song takes the place of Zhou.

note: 「繼衝但俟保寅、延嗣之還，遽聞宋師奄至，即惶恐出迎，遇處耘於江陵北十五里」（續資治通鑑·卷3） 宋取荊南、湖南（範圍約略）
noteEn: "Jichong was only waiting for Baoyin and Yansi to come back when he heard that the army of Song was suddenly upon him; in alarm he went out to meet it and came on Chuyun fifteen li north of Jiangling." Song takes Jingnan and Hunan.

note: 「湖南平，凡得州十四，監一，縣六十六，戶九萬七千二百八十八」（續資治通鑑·卷3） （周氏所有湖南諸州盡入宋）
noteEn: "Hunan was pacified: fourteen prefectures, one industrial prefecture, sixty-six counties and 97,288 households were gained in all." All the prefectures of Hunan held by the Zhou family pass to Song.

note: 「己卯，遣通奏太原伊審徵奉降表詣軍前」（續資治通鑑·卷4） 宋滅後蜀（範圍約略）
noteEn: "On the day jimao he sent Yi Shenzheng of Taiyuan, his commissioner for memorials, to the army with the letter of surrender." Song destroys Later Shu.

note: 概覽（約略） 丁部領建大瞿越
noteEn: Dinh Bo Linh founds Dai Co Viet.

note: 「辛未，師至白田，南漢主素服出降，潘美承制釋之」（續資治通鑑·卷6） 宋滅南漢（範圍約略）
noteEn: "On the day xinwei the army reached Baitian; the ruler of Southern Han came out in plain dress to surrender, and Pan Mei, by the authority given him, set him free." Song destroys Southern Han.

note: 「彬整軍成列，至其宮城，國主乃奉表納降，與其群臣迎拜於門」（續資治通鑑·卷8） 宋滅南唐（範圍約略）
noteEn: "Bin drew his army up in order and came to the palace city; the ruler then offered his letter of surrender and with his ministers came out to bow at the gate." Song destroys Southern Tang.

note: 「俶遂決策，上表獻所管十三州，一軍」（續資治通鑑·卷9） 吳越納土（範圍約略）
noteEn: "Chu then made up his mind and sent up a letter offering the thirteen prefectures and one command he governed." Wuyue gives up its land.

note: 「夜，漏上十刻，北漢主乃遣客省使李勳上表納款」（續資治通鑑·卷10） 宋滅北漢（範圍約略）
noteEn: "In the night, at the tenth mark of the water-clock, the ruler of Northern Han at last sent Li Xun, commissioner of the visitors' bureau, with a letter of submission." Song destroys Northern Han.

note: 「己酉，夏州留後李繼捧來朝，獻其銀、夏、綏、宥四州」（續資治通鑑·卷11）「繼遷所設伏兵盡起，光實被害，遂襲據銀州」（續資治通鑑·卷12） 李繼遷叛宋，據銀州
noteEn: "On the day jiyou Li Jipeng, acting governor of Xiazhou, came to court and offered his four prefectures of Yin, Xia, Sui and You." "The ambush Jiqian had laid rose all at once; Guangshi was killed, and he surprised and held Yinzhou." Li Jiqian rebels against Song and holds Yinzhou.

note: 概覽（約略） 喀喇汗滅于闐
noteEn: The Karakhanids destroy Khotan.

note: 概覽（約略） 党項取甘、涼
noteEn: The Tanguts take Ganzhou and Liangzhou.

note: 「再舉兵攻回紇瓜、沙肅三州，盡有河西故地」（續資治通鑑·卷40） 党項取瓜、沙（範圍約略）
noteEn: "He raised troops again and attacked the three Uyghur prefectures of Gua, Sha and Su, and held all the old land of Hexi." The Tanguts take Guazhou and Shazhou.

note: 「甲戌，趙元昊築壇受冊，僭號大夏始文英武興法建禮仁孝皇帝，改大慶二年為天授禮法延祚元年」（續資治通鑑·卷41） 元昊稱帝，國號大夏（範圍約略）
noteEn: "On the day jiaxu Zhao Yuanhao built an altar and received investiture, usurping the title Emperor Shiwen Yingwu Xingfa Jianli Renxiao of the Great Xia, and changed the second year of Daqing to the first year of Tianshou Lifa Yanzuo." Yuanhao takes the title of emperor and names his state Great Xia.

note: 「秦鳳路沿邊安撫王韶復武勝軍。」（熙寧五年）「王韶復河州」「王韶入岷州」（六年）（宋史·神宗紀）
noteEn: "Wang Shao, border pacification commissioner of the Qinfeng circuit, recovered the Wusheng command" (fifth year of Xining). "Wang Shao recovered Hezhou." "Wang Shao entered Minzhou" (sixth year).

note: 「乙卯，引大軍至鄯州，偽龜茲公主青宜結牟及其酋豪李河溫率回紇、于闐、般次諸族大小首領等開門出降，鄯州平」（續資治通鑑·卷88） 宋取湟、鄯（州目據所引文）（湟州、廓州無州治之點，不另列）
noteEn: "On the day yimao he led the main army to Shanzhou; the so-called Princess of Qiuci, Qingyi Jiemou, and the chief Li Hewen, with the greater and lesser heads of the Uyghur, Khotanese and Banci peoples, opened the gates and came out to surrender, and Shanzhou was pacified." Song takes Huangzhou and Shanzhou (those the passage lists; Huangzhou and Kuozhou have no seat marked and are not shown).

note: 收國元年正月，阿骨打即皇帝位，國號大金（金史·太祖紀）
noteEn: In the first month of the first year of Shouguo, Aguda takes the throne as emperor and names his state the Great Jin.

note: 「於是遼之東京州縣及南路系遼女直皆降于金」（續資治通鑑·卷92） 金取遼東京（範圍約略）
noteEn: "Then the prefectures and counties of the Liao Eastern Capital, and the Jurchen of the southern route who were on the Liao registers, all surrendered to Jin." Jin takes the Liao Eastern Capital.

note: 「諸軍鼓噪而進，自旦及巳，棟摩以麾下先登，克其外城，留守托卜嘉以城降」（續資治通鑑·卷93） 金取遼上京（人名為清代改譯）（範圍約略）
noteEn: "The armies advanced with drums and shouting; from dawn to mid-morning Dongmo with his own men was first up the wall and took the outer city, and the regent Tuobujia surrendered the city." Jin takes the Liao Supreme Capital (the names are in the Qing dynasty's respelling).

note: 「乙亥，陷遼中京，遂下澤州」（續資治通鑑·卷94） 金取遼中京、西京（範圍約略）
noteEn: "On the day yihai the Liao Central Capital fell, and Zezhou was then taken." Jin takes the Liao Central and Western Capitals.

note: 「壬辰，使楊璞齎誓書，以燕京及涿、易、檀、順、景、薊六州來歸」（續資治通鑑·卷95） 金以燕京及六州歸宋（景州無州治之點，不另列）
noteEn: "On the day renchen Yang Pu was sent with the sworn letter, handing over Yanjing and the six prefectures of Zhuo, Yi, Tan, Shun, Jing and Ji." Jin hands Yanjing and the six prefectures to Song (Jingzhou has no seat marked and is not shown).

note: 概覽（約略） 耶律大石西走，後建西遼
noteEn: Yelü Dashi goes west, and later founds Western Liao.

note: 「壬戌，遼主行至應州新城東六十里，為金將洛索所執，遼亡」（續資治通鑑·卷95） 遼天祚帝被擒，遼亡 （遼所餘之地並入金）
noteEn: "On the day renxu the ruler of Liao, sixty li east of Xincheng in Yingzhou, was seized by the Jin general Luosuo, and Liao ended." Emperor Tianzuo of Liao is captured and Liao ends; what Liao still held passes to Jin.

note: 「宗望至燕山，藥師率軍郊迎之，執靖及都轉運使呂頤浩、副使李與權以降」（續資治通鑑·卷95） 金背盟南下，取燕山府（燕京及六州；景州無州治之點，不另列）
noteEn: "Zongwang reached Yanshan; Yaoshi led his army out to welcome him, and seized Jing, the chief transport commissioner Lü Yihao and his deputy Li Yuquan, and surrendered." Jin breaks the covenant and comes south, taking Yanshan (Yanjing and the six prefectures; Jingzhou has no seat marked and is not shown).

note: 靖康二年四月，金人以徽、欽二帝北歸，北宋亡（宋史·欽宗紀） 河北、河東諸州（先陷、後陷者各見本條；其餘約略）
noteEn: In the fourth month of the second year of Jingkang the Jin carry the emperors Huizong and Qinzong north, and Northern Song ends. The prefectures of Hebei and Hedong: those that fell earlier or later have their own entries, and the rest are approximate.

note: 「庚申，金人侵東平府，守臣寶文閣直學士、京東西路安撫制置使權邦彥遁去」（續資治通鑑·卷102） 金取京東、河北大名及京西、淮北諸州（各州陷落之年多不詳，約略；汴京與先後陷者各見本條）
noteEn: "On the day gengshen the Jin attacked Dongping; its commander Quan Bangyan, academician of the Baowen Pavilion and pacification commissioner of Jingdong West, fled." Jin takes Jingdong, Daming in Hebei, and the prefectures of Jingxi and north of the Huai (for most the year of the fall is not known; Bianjing and those that fell before or after have their own entries).

note: 「遣高慶裔、韓昉冊命劉豫為皇帝，國號大齊，都大名府」（續資治通鑑·卷108） 金立劉豫為齊帝 齊所有：京東、京西、淮北及大名（據金志諸路之州，約略）
noteEn: "Gao Qingyi and Han Fang were sent to invest Liu Yu as emperor, with the state named Great Qi and the capital at Daming." Jin sets up Liu Yu as emperor of Qi, which holds Jingdong, Jingxi, the land north of the Huai and Daming (the prefectures of those circuits in the Jin treatise, approximately).

note: 「於是盡失陝西地，但餘階、成、岷、鳳、洮五郡及鳳翔府之和尚原、隴州之方山原而已」（續資治通鑑·卷109） 金取陝西（州目據金志五路）
noteEn: "So all of Shaanxi was lost; only the five prefectures of Jie, Cheng, Min, Feng and Tao were left, with Heshangyuan in Fengxiang and Fangshanyuan in Longzhou." Jin takes Shaanxi (the prefectures are those of the five circuits in the Jin treatise).

note: 概覽（約略）
概覽（約略） 高昌回鶻臣屬西遼
noteEn: The Uyghurs of Gaochang become subjects of Western Liao.

note: 概覽（約略） 西夏取西寧州
noteEn: Western Xia takes Xiningzhou.

note: 「丙午，金人廢劉豫為蜀王」（續資治通鑑·卷119） 金廢劉豫，齊所有之地盡入金
noteEn: "On the day bingwu the Jin deposed Liu Yu and made him King of Shu." Jin deposes Liu Yu, and all that Qi held passes to Jin.

note: 紹興和議：「以淮水中流為界，西有唐、鄧州割屬上國」（金史·宗弼傳）
noteEn: The peace of Shaoxing: "the middle of the Huai River is the border, and in the west Tangzhou and Dengzhou are ceded to the superior state".

note: 「至是贊謨與剛中相見，首謂「階、成、祐、鳳、商、秦六州當還上國」（續資治通鑑·卷125） 和議劃界，金索商、秦諸州；圖上只及秦州，其界存疑
noteEn: "Now Zanmo met Gangzhong and said first that the six prefectures of Jie, Cheng, You, Feng, Shang and Qin should be returned to the superior state." The border is drawn under the peace, and Jin demands Shang, Qin and the others; the map shows only Qinzhou, and its line is in doubt.

note: 鐵木真即大汗位於斡難河源（元史·太祖紀）
noteEn: Temüjin takes the place of great khan at the source of the Onon.

note: 「是春，輝和爾國降於蒙古」（續資治通鑑·卷158） 高昌回鶻歸附蒙古（「輝和爾」為清代改譯，即畏兀兒）（範圍約略）
noteEn: "In this spring the Uyghur state surrendered to the Mongols." The Uyghurs of Gaochang submit to the Mongols (the name in the passage is the Qing dynasty's respelling).

note: 「五月，庚申，承暉作遺表，付尚書省令史師安石書之，皆論國家大計及果勒齊奸狀，且謝不能終保都城之罪，從容若平日」（續資治通鑑·卷160） 蒙古陷中都（承暉殉於五月庚申，城遂陷）（範圍約略）
noteEn: "In the fifth month, on the day gengshen, Chenghui composed his last memorial and gave it to Shi Anshi, a clerk of the Department of State Affairs, to write out: all of it on the great affairs of the state and the treachery of Guoleqi, with an apology for failing to keep the capital to the end, as calm as on any other day." The Mongols take the Central Capital (Chenghui died on that day, and the city then fell).

note: 概覽（約略） 蒙古滅西遼
noteEn: The Mongols destroy Western Liao.

note: 「戊寅，自西京由太和嶺入河東，攻太原、忻、代、澤、潞、汾、霍等州，悉降之。」（元史·木華黎傳）河北諸郡則於丁丑年木華黎南下時陸續攻取（約略）
noteEn: "In the year wuyin he went from the Western Capital by the Taihe range into Hedong and attacked Taiyuan, Xin, Dai, Ze, Lu, Fen, Huo and other prefectures, and all surrendered." The prefectures of Hebei were taken one after another when Muqali came south in the year dingchou.

note: 「是月，夏國主睍力屈出降，遂縶以歸」（續資治通鑑·卷164） 蒙古滅西夏（範圍約略）
noteEn: "In this month Xian, ruler of Xia, his strength spent, came out and surrendered, and was taken away bound." The Mongols destroy Western Xia.

note: 「三年辛卯春二月，克鳳翔」（元史·太宗紀）
noteEn: "In spring of the third year, xinmao, the second month, Fengxiang was taken."

note: 「帝圍河中。十二月己未，拔之。」（元史·太宗紀）
noteEn: "The emperor besieged Hezhong. In the twelfth month, on the day jiwei, he took it."

note: 三峯山之後「遂下商、虢、嵩、汝、陝、洛、許、鄭、陳、亳、潁、壽、睢、永等州。」（元史·太宗紀）（州與郡的對應為約略）
noteEn: After Sanfeng Mountain "the prefectures of Shang, Guo, Song, Ru, Shan, Luo, Xu, Zheng, Chen, Bo, Ying, Shou, Sui, Yong and others then fell". How the prefectures match the commanderies drawn is approximate.

note: 「戊辰，金西面元帥崔立殺留守完顏奴申、完顏習捏阿不，以南京降。」（元史·太宗紀）
noteEn: "On the day wuchen Cui Li, the Jin marshal of the western side, killed the regents Wanyan Nushen and Wanyan Xinie'abu and surrendered the Southern Capital."

note: 哀宗走蔡州，金亡（金史·哀宗紀下）
noteEn: Emperor Aizong flees to Caizhou, and Jin ends.

note: 「戊辰，史嵩之露佈告金亡，以陳，蔡西北地分屬蒙古，蒙古命劉福為河南道總管」（續資治通鑑·卷167）（範圍約略）
noteEn: "On the day wuchen Shi Songzhi announced by open dispatch that Jin had fallen; the land north-west of Chen and Cai was assigned to the Mongols, who appointed Liu Fu chief administrator of the Henan circuit."

note: 概覽（約略） 涼州會盟，吐蕃歸附蒙古
noteEn: The meeting at Liangzhou; Tibet submits to the Mongols.

note: 「十二月，丙辰，蒙古中道兵薄大理城」（續資治通鑑·卷174） 忽必烈滅大理（範圍約略）
noteEn: "In the twelfth month, on the day bingchen, the Mongol army of the middle route came up to the city of Dali." Khubilai destroys Dali.

note: 樊城破，呂文煥以襄陽降（元史·世祖紀五）
noteEn: Fancheng is stormed, and Lü Wenhuan surrenders Xiangyang.

note: 「賈似道以精稅七萬餘人盡屬孫虎臣，軍于池州之下流丁家洲，夏貴以戰艦二千五百艘橫亙江中，似道自將後軍軍魯港」（續資治通鑑·卷181） 元軍沿江東下（範圍約略）
noteEn: "Jia Sidao put all his seventy thousand and more picked troops under Sun Huchen, who camped at Dingjiazhou, downstream of Chizhou; Xia Gui drew two thousand five hundred warships across the river, and Sidao himself led the rear at Lugang." The Yuan army comes east down the Yangtze.

note: 「帝率文武百僚詣祥曦殿望元闕上表，乞為籓輔」（續資治通鑑·卷182） 臨安降（範圍約略）
noteEn: "The emperor led his civil and military officials to the Xiangxi Hall and, facing toward the Yuan court, sent up a letter asking to be its vassal." Lin'an surrenders.

note: 崖山之戰，宋亡（宋史·瀛國公紀）
noteEn: The battle of Yashan; Song ends.

note: 「十一月，甲子，祿山發所部兵及同羅、奚、契丹、室韋凡十五萬眾，號二十萬，反於范陽」「河北皆祿山統內，所過州縣，望風瓦解」（資治通鑑·卷217） 安祿山起兵，河北諸郡（範圍約略）
noteEn: "In the eleventh month, on the day jiazi, Lushan called out the troops under him with the Tongluo, Xi, Khitan and Shiwei, a hundred and fifty thousand in all, called two hundred thousand, and rebelled at Fanyang." "All Hebei was under Lushan's command, and the prefectures and counties he passed fell apart at the news." An Lushan rises, with the commanderies of Hebei.

note: 「丁酉，祿山陷東京，賊鼓噪自四門入，縱兵殺掠」（資治通鑑·卷217） 陷陳留、滎陽、東京（範圍約略）
noteEn: "On the day dingyou Lushan took the eastern capital; the rebels came in by the four gates with drums and shouting and were let loose to kill and plunder." Chenliu, Xingyang and the eastern capital fall.

note: 「未幾，吐蕃圍涼州，士卒不為用；志烈奔甘州，為沙陀所殺，涼州遂陷」（資治通鑑·卷223）（州目據所引文）
noteEn: "Before long Tibet besieged Liangzhou, and the soldiers would not fight for him; Zhilie fled to Ganzhou and was killed by the Shatuo, and Liangzhou fell."

note: 「三月，歸義節度使張義潮奏自將蕃、漢兵七千克復涼州」（資治通鑑·卷250）（州目據所引文）
noteEn: "In the third month Zhang Yichao, military governor of Guiyi, reported that he had himself led seven thousand Tibetan and Chinese troops and recovered Liangzhou."

note: 「楊素薦瓜州刺史長安劉方有將帥之略，詔以方為交州道行軍總管，統二十七營而進」（資治通鑑·卷179） 劉方平李佛子，交州復入隋
noteEn: "Yang Su recommended Liu Fang of Chang'an, prefect of Guazhou, as having a general's grasp; an edict made Fang field commander of the Jiaozhou route, and he advanced with twenty-seven battalions." Liu Fang puts down Li Fozi (Ly Phat Tu), and Jiaozhou is Sui's again.

note: 「南詔乘亂陷越巂會同軍，據清溪關；尋傳、驃國皆降之」（資治通鑑·卷218）
noteEn: "Nanzhao used the disorder to take the Huitong command in Yuexi and hold the Qingxi pass; the Xunchuan and the kingdom of Pyu both submitted to it."

note: 「癸亥，以史朝義降將薛嵩為相、衛、邢、洺、貝、磁六州節度使，田承嗣為魏、博、德、滄、瀛五州都防禦使，李懷仙仍故地為幽州、盧龍節度使」（資治通鑑·卷222） 薛嵩所領六州屬唐（磁州無州治之點，不另列）
noteEn: "On the day guihai Shi Chaoyi's surrendered generals were appointed: Xue Song military governor of the six prefectures of Xiang, Wei, Xing, Ming, Bei and Ci; Tian Chengsi defence commissioner of the five prefectures of Wei, Bo, De, Cang and Ying; and Li Huaixian, in his old territory, military governor of Youzhou and Lulong." The six prefectures under Xue Song belong to Tang (Cizhou has no seat marked and is not shown).

note: 「時河北諸州皆已降，嵩等迎僕固懷恩，拜於馬首，乞行間自效；懷恩亦恐賊平寵衰，故奏留嵩等及李寶臣分帥河北，自為黨援」（資治通鑑·卷222） 其餘州縣復歸唐
noteEn: "By then the prefectures of Hebei had all surrendered. Song and the others met Pugu Huai'en, bowed at his horse's head and begged to serve in the ranks; Huai'en, for his part, feared that with the rebels gone his favour would fade, and so memorialised to leave Song and the others and Li Baochen in command of parts of Hebei, as allies of his own." The other prefectures and counties return to Tang.

note: 「契丹陷平州」（資治通鑑·卷276）
noteEn: "The Khitan took Pingzhou."

note: 「契丹陷平州」（資治通鑑·卷276） 營州、安東、單于故地入契丹之年史文不詳，姑繫於此
noteEn: "The Khitan took Pingzhou." The year in which Yingzhou and the old lands of the Andong and Chanyu commands passed to the Khitan is not given in the histories; they are put here for want of a better date.

note: 「既用其策，以夏、綏、銀、宥、靜五州賜趙保吉」（續資治通鑑·卷19）（宥州、靜州無州治之點，不另列）
noteEn: "His plan was adopted, and the five prefectures of Xia, Sui, Yin, You and Jing were granted to Zhao Baoji." Youzhou and Jingzhou have no seat marked and are not shown.

note: 「三月，李繼遷大集蕃部攻陷靈州，知州、內客省使、順州團練使裴濟死之」（續資治通鑑·卷23） （鹽州並陷，文不另見）
noteEn: "In the third month Li Jiqian gathered the tribes in force and took Lingzhou; its prefect Pei Ji, commissioner of the inner visitors' bureau and militia commander of Shunzhou, died there." Yanzhou fell with it, though no passage says so separately.

note: 「成、階二州皆降，蜀人振恐」「戊申，克鳳州，擒蜀威武節度使王環及都監趙崇溥等將士五千人」（資治通鑑·卷292） 周取秦、鳳、成、階四州
noteEn: "The two prefectures of Cheng and Jie both surrendered, and the men of Shu were shaken." "On the day wushen Fengzhou was taken, with Wang Huan, Shu's military governor of Weiwu, the inspector-general Zhao Chongpu, and five thousand officers and men." Zhou takes the four prefectures of Qin, Feng, Cheng and Jie.

note: 「甲辰，遼師齊進，東京騎將夏貞顯之子仙壽先登，易州遂破，刺史劉墀降於遼」（續資治通鑑·卷14）
noteEn: "On the day jiachen the armies of Liao advanced together; Xianshou, son of Xia Zhenxian, a cavalry officer of the Eastern Capital, was first up the wall, Yizhou fell, and its prefect Liu Chi surrendered to Liao."

note: 「五月，辛巳，以古謂砦為通遠軍」（續資治通鑑·卷69） 通遠軍（後升鞏州）
noteEn: "In the fifth month, on the day xinsi, the fort of Guwei was made the Tongyuan command." The Tongyuan command, later raised to Gongzhou.

note: 「李憲復蘭州古城」（續資治通鑑·卷76）
noteEn: "Li Xian recovered the old city of Lanzhou."

note: 「梁初，天下別為十一國，南有吳、浙、荊、湖、閩、漢，西有岐、蜀，北有燕、晉，而朱氏所有七十八州以為梁」（新五代史·卷60 職方考） 表列梁初屬梁者：汴、洛、雍、兗、沂、密、青、㴩、齊、棣、登、萊、徐、宿、鄆、曹、濮、宋、亳、單、潁、陳、蔡、許、汝、鄭、滑、襄、均、房、金、鄧、隨、郢、唐、復、安、申、蒲、孟、懷、晉、絳、陝、虢、華、商、同、夏、銀、綏、宥、靈、鹽、魏、博、貝、衞、澶、相、邢、洺、磁、鎮、冀、深、趙、易、祁、定
noteEn: "At the beginning of Liang the world was divided into eleven states: in the south Wu, Zhe, Jing, Hu, Min and Han; in the west Qi and Shu; in the north Yan and Jin; and the seventy-eight prefectures the Zhu family held made up Liang." The table lists the seventy prefectures that were Liang's at the beginning of Liang; their names are in the Chinese note.

note: 「梁初，天下別為十一國，南有吳、浙、荊、湖、閩、漢，西有岐、蜀，北有燕、晉，而朱氏所有七十八州以為梁」（新五代史·卷60 職方考） 表列梁初屬晉（河東）者：忻、代、嵐、石、憲、麟、府、并、汾、慈、隰、澤、潞、沁、遼

The table lists as Jin's (Hedong) at the beginning of Liang: Xin, Dai, Lan, Shi, Xian, Lin, Fu, Bing, Fen, Ci, Xi, Ze, Lu, Qin and Liao.

The table lists the twenty prefectures that were Qi's at the beginning of Liang; their names are in the Chinese note.

The table lists the forty-eight prefectures that were Shu's at the beginning of Liang; their names are in the Chinese note.

note: 「梁初，天下別為十一國，南有吳、浙、荊、湖、閩、漢，西有岐、蜀，北有燕、晉，而朱氏所有七十八州以為梁」（新五代史·卷60 職方考） 表列梁初屬吳者：揚、楚、泗、滁、和、光、黃、舒、蘄、廬、壽、海、泰、濠、潤、常、宣、歙、鄂、昇、池、饒、信、江、撫、袁、吉、虔

The table lists the twenty-eight prefectures that were Wu's at the beginning of Liang; their names are in the Chinese note.

The table lists as Wuyue's (Zhe) at the beginning of Liang: Hang, Yue, Su, Hu, Wen, Tai, Ming, Chu, Qu, Wu and Mu.

note: 「梁初，天下別為十一國，南有吳、浙、荊、湖、閩、漢，西有岐、蜀，北有燕、晉，而朱氏所有七十八州以為梁」（新五代史·卷60 職方考） 表列梁初屬荊南者：荊
noteEn: "At the beginning of Liang the world was divided into eleven states: in the south Wu, Zhe, Jing, Hu, Min and Han; in the west Qi and Shu; in the north Yan and Jin; and the seventy-eight prefectures the Zhu family held made up Liang." The table lists as Jingnan's at the beginning of Liang the one prefecture of Jing.

note: 「梁初，天下別為十一國，南有吳、浙、荊、湖、閩、漢，西有岐、蜀，北有燕、晉，而朱氏所有七十八州以為梁」（新五代史·卷60 職方考） 表列梁初屬楚（湖）者：潭、衡、澧、朗、岳、道、永、邵、辰、融、郴、連、昭、宜、桂、賀、梧、蒙、嚴、富、柳、象
noteEn: "At the beginning of Liang the world was divided into eleven states: in the south Wu, Zhe, Jing, Hu, Min and Han; in the west Qi and Shu; in the north Yan and Jin; and the seventy-eight prefectures the Zhu family held made up Liang." The table lists the twenty-two prefectures that were Chu's (Hu) at the beginning of Liang; their names are in the Chinese note.

note: 「梁初，天下別為十一國，南有吳、浙、荊、湖、閩、漢，西有岐、蜀，北有燕、晉，而朱氏所有七十八州以為梁」（新五代史·卷60 職方考） 表列梁初屬閩者：建、汀、漳、泉、福
noteEn: "At the beginning of Liang the world was divided into eleven states: in the south Wu, Zhe, Jing, Hu, Min and Han; in the west Qi and Shu; in the north Yan and Jin; and the seventy-eight prefectures the Zhu family held made up Liang." The table lists as Min's at the beginning of Liang: Jian, Ting, Zhang, Quan and Fu.

note: 「梁初，天下別為十一國，南有吳、浙、荊、湖、閩、漢，西有岐、蜀，北有燕、晉，而朱氏所有七十八州以為梁」（新五代史·卷60 職方考） 表列梁初屬南漢者：容、邕、端、康、封、恩、春、新、高、竇、雷、化化、韶、藤、白、廉、欽、廣、橫、賓、潯、惠、鬱林、瓊、崖、儋、萬安、羅、潘、勤、瀧、辨
noteEn: "At the beginning of Liang the world was divided into eleven states: in the south Wu, Zhe, Jing, Hu, Min and Han; in the west Qi and Shu; in the north Yan and Jin; and the seventy-eight prefectures the Zhu family held made up Liang." The table lists the thirty-two prefectures that were Southern Han's at the beginning of Liang; their names are in the Chinese note.

note: 「義昌節度使劉守文聞其弟守光幽其父，集將吏大哭曰：「不意吾家生此梟獍」（資治通鑑·卷266） 滄、景、德（義昌）在劉守文，與燕一家；表於梁世只書其後入晉
noteEn: "Liu Shouwen, military governor of Yichang, hearing that his younger brother Shouguang had imprisoned their father, gathered his officers and wept aloud: I never thought our house would breed such an unnatural beast." Cang, Jing and De, the Yichang command, are Liu Shouwen's, of one family with Yan; for the Liang years the table records only that they later passed to Jin.

note: 「師厚、守奇自弓高渡御河而東，逼滄州，張萬進懼，請遷於河南；師厚表徙萬進鎮青州，以守奇為順化節度使」（資治通鑑·卷268） 梁取滄州
noteEn: "Shihou and Shouqi crossed the Yu River at Gonggao and went east, pressing Cangzhou; Zhang Wanjin, afraid, asked to be moved south of the Yellow River, and Shihou memorialised to move him to the command of Qingzhou and make Shouqi military governor of Shunhua." Liang takes Cangzhou.

note: 「辛卯，丹州刺史崔公實請降」（資治通鑑·卷267） 梁取丹、延、鄜、坊於岐
noteEn: "On the day xinmao Cui Gongshi, prefect of Danzhou, asked to surrender." Liang takes Dan, Yan, Fu and Fang from Qi.

note: 「李繼徽假子保衡殺李彥魯，自稱靜難留後，舉邠、寧二州來附」（資治通鑑·卷269） （耀、慶、衍入梁之年不詳，並繫於此）
noteEn: "Baoheng, adopted son of Li Jihui, killed Li Yanlu, called himself acting governor of Jingnan, and came over with the two prefectures of Bin and Ning." The year Yao, Qing and Yan passed to Liang is not known; they are put here with them.

note: 「興州刺史王宗鐸克階州，降其刺史李彥安」（資治通鑑·卷269） 蜀取秦、鳳、階、成於岐（鳳州在次年）
noteEn: "Wang Zongduo, prefect of Xingzhou, took Jiezhou and received the surrender of its prefect Li Yan'an." Shu takes Qin, Feng, Jie and Cheng from Qi (Fengzhou in the next year).

note: 《職方考》表：金州梁世「有　蜀」（新五代史·卷60 職方考） 先屬梁，後入蜀；其年不詳，姑自梁初繫之
noteEn: The table of the Treatise on the Prefectures has Jinzhou, under Liang, as "held; Shu": Liang's first, then Shu's. The year is not known, and it is put from the beginning of Liang for want of a better date.

note: 「晉王自將攻邢州，昭德節度使張筠棄相州走」（資治通鑑·卷269） 晉取相、邢、洺、磁
noteEn: "The King of Jin led the attack on Xingzhou himself, and Zhang Yun, military governor of Zhaode, abandoned Xiangzhou and fled." Jin takes Xiang, Xing, Ming and Ci.

note: 「晉人以兵逼滄州，順化節度使戴思遠棄城奔東都」（資治通鑑·卷269） 晉取滄、景、德
noteEn: "The men of Jin pressed Cangzhou with troops, and Dai Siyuan, military governor of Shunhua, abandoned the city and fled to the eastern capital." Jin takes Cang, Jing and De.

note: 「岐王聞帝入洛，內不自安，遣其子行軍司馬彰義節度使兼侍中繼曮入貢，始上表稱臣」（資治通鑑·卷273） 岐王稱臣，其地入後唐
noteEn: "The King of Qi, hearing that the emperor had entered Luoyang, was uneasy, and sent his son Jiyan, his chief of staff, military governor of Zhangyi and palace attendant, with tribute; for the first time he sent up a letter calling himself a subject." The King of Qi declares himself a subject, and his land passes to Later Tang.

note: 「壬辰，寧江節度使西方鄴攻拔歸州；未幾，荊南復取之」（資治通鑑·卷276） 歸、峽入荊南（其年不詳，至是見於史文）
noteEn: "On the day renchen Xifang Ye, military governor of Ningjiang, attacked and took Guizhou; before long Jingnan took it back." Gui and Xia pass to Jingnan (the year is not known; this is where the histories first show it).

note: 「石氏入立，獻十有六州于契丹，而得蜀金州」（新五代史·卷60 職方考）
noteEn: "When the Shi family came to the throne it gave sixteen prefectures to the Khitan, and gained Jinzhou from Shu."

note: 「吳越兵既登岸，大呼奮擊，延魯不能御，棄眾而走，孟堅戰死」（資治通鑑·卷286） 福州入吳越（閩之餘地並入）
noteEn: "The troops of Wuyue, once ashore, charged with a great shout; Yanlu could not hold them, abandoned his men and fled, and Meng Jian died fighting." Fuzhou passes to Wuyue, with what was left of Min.

note: 「雄武節度使何重建斬契丹使者，以秦、成、階三州降蜀」（資治通鑑·卷286） （鳳州繼入蜀）
noteEn: "He Chongjian, military governor of Xiongwu, beheaded the Khitan envoy and surrendered the three prefectures of Qin, Cheng and Jie to Shu." Fengzhou passed to Shu after them.

note: 「懷恩因以兵略定宜、連、梧、嚴、富、昭、柳、象、龔等州，南漢始盡有嶺南之地」（資治通鑑·卷290） 表列自楚入南漢者：融、郴、連、昭、宜、桂、賀、梧、蒙、嚴、富、柳、象
noteEn: "Huai'en then took Yi, Lian, Wu, Yan, Fu, Zhao, Liu, Xiang, Gong and other prefectures with his troops, and Southern Han for the first time held all the land of Lingnan." The table lists as passing from Chu to Southern Han: Rong, Chen, Lian, Zhao, Yi, Gui, He, Wu, Meng, Yan, Fu, Liu and Xiang.

note: 「乃歸岳州，使團練判官李簡帥朗州將吏迎武安節度使周行逢」（資治通鑑·卷292） 湖南歸周行逢（劉言、王逵先據之，見952年；唐兵退出之文未檢得）
noteEn: "He then went back to Yuezhou and sent the militia judge Li Jian with the officers of Langzhou to welcome Zhou Xingfeng, military governor of Wu'an." Hunan passes to Zhou Xingfeng (Liu Yan and Wang Kui held it first: see 952; no passage on the withdrawal of the Tang troops was found).

note: 「長驅至代州，守將李嗣本率兵拒守，漢兒又擒嗣本以降，遂破代州」（續資治通鑑·卷95） 金取代州
noteEn: "They drove straight to Daizhou; the commander Li Siben led his troops to hold it, but the Chinese soldiers seized Siben and surrendered, and Daizhou fell." Jin takes Daizhou.

note: 「九月，丙寅，金人破太原府」（續資治通鑑·卷97） 金取太原府
noteEn: "In the ninth month, on the day bingyin, the Jin took Taiyuan." Jin takes Taiyuan.

note: 「金人破真定府，知府李邈、兵馬都鈐轄劉翊死之」「丙辰，金人入平陽府」（續資治通鑑·卷97） 金取真定府、平陽府
noteEn: "The Jin took Zhending; the prefect Li Miao and the military director Liu Yi died there." "On the day bingchen the Jin entered Pingyang." Jin takes Zhending and Pingyang.

note: 「金人破河中府，貴州防禦使、權府事郝仲連死之」（續資治通鑑·卷98） 金取河中府
noteEn: "The Jin took Hezhong; Hao Zhonglian, defence commissioner of Guizhou and acting prefect, died there." Jin takes Hezhong.

note: 「俄金人復來，磁無城，不可守，昱率其眾以奔，金人破磁州」（續資治通鑑·卷99） 金取磁州
noteEn: "Soon the Jin came again; Ci had no wall and could not be held, Yu led his people away, and the Jin took Cizhou." Jin takes Cizhou.

note: 「辛亥，金人破河間府」（續資治通鑑·卷100） 金取河間府
noteEn: "On the day xinhai the Jin took Hejian." Jin takes Hejian.

note: 「三月，辛卯，金人破中山府」（續資治通鑑·卷101） 金取中山府
noteEn: "In the third month, on the day xinmao, the Jin took Zhongshan." Jin takes Zhongshan.

note: 「甲辰，洛索破絳州，權知州事趙某率軍民巷戰，凡六日」（續資治通鑑·卷101） 金取絳州
noteEn: "On the day jiachen Luosuo took Jiangzhou; the acting prefect, a man named Zhao, led soldiers and people in fighting street by street for six days." Jin takes Jiangzhou.

note: 「癸巳，金人破冀州，權知軍州事單某自縊死」（續資治通鑑·卷102） 金取冀州
noteEn: "On the day guisi the Jin took Jizhou; the acting prefect, a man named Shan, hanged himself." Jin takes Jizhou.

note: 「壬辰，金人破延安府，通判魏彥明死之」「金詭道陷丹州，州界於鄜、延之間，庶乃自當鄜州來路，遣統制官龐世才、鄭恩當延安來路」「乙未，金人破濮州」（續資治通鑑·卷102） 金取延安府、丹州、濮州、德州、淄州
noteEn: "On the day renchen the Jin took Yan'an; the vice-prefect Wei Yanming died there." "The Jin took Danzhou by a side road. The prefecture lies between Fu and Yan; Shu himself then barred the road from Fuzhou and sent the commanders Pang Shicai and Zheng En to bar the road from Yan'an." "On the day yiwei the Jin took Puzhou." Jin takes Yan'an, Danzhou, Puzhou, Dezhou and Zizhou.

note: 「金人破襲慶府，衍聖公孔端友已避兵南支」「乙丑，金人破虢州」（續資治通鑑·卷102） 金取襲慶府、虢州
noteEn: "The Jin took Xiqing; Kong Duanyou, the Duke Yansheng, had already gone south out of the way of the armies." "On the day yichou the Jin took Guozhou." Jin takes Xiqing and Guozhou.

note: 「丙午，金左副元帥宗翰破徐州，守臣龍圖閣待制王復死之」「己酉，金人破泗州」（續資治通鑑·卷103） 金取徐州、泗州
noteEn: "On the day bingwu Zonghan, the Jin deputy marshal of the left, took Xuzhou; its commander Wang Fu, edict attendant of the Longtu Pavilion, died there." "On the day jiyou the Jin took Sizhou." Jin takes Xuzhou and Sizhou.

note: 「是日，金人破滄州」（續資治通鑑·卷103） 金取滄州
noteEn: "On this day the Jin took Cangzhou." Jin takes Cangzhou.

note: 「權鄜延經略使郭浩駐兵境上，金人遂破鄜州」（續資治通鑑·卷104） 金取鄜州
noteEn: "Guo Hao, acting military commissioner of Fuyan, kept his troops on the border, and the Jin then took Fuzhou." Jin takes Fuzhou.

note: 「金以輕兵破涇州，次潘原縣，錡留彥琪捍洧，親率精銳赴渭州」（續資治通鑑·卷108） 金取涇州
noteEn: "The Jin took Jingzhou with a light force and halted at Panyuan county; Qi left Yanqi to hold them and himself led his best troops to Weizhou." Jin takes Jingzhou.

note: 「先是金人破京師，時河南之北悉為金所有，睢、洛皆屯重兵，惟汴京及畿邑猶為宋固守，而糧儲乏絕，四面不通，多饑死」（續資治通鑑·卷107） 汴京陷（敘於是年二月金師北還之際）
noteEn: "Before this the Jin had taken the capital. By then all the north of Henan was Jin's, with strong forces at Sui and Luo; only Bianjing and its home counties were still held for Song, and with the stores of grain gone and every road cut, many starved." Bianjing falls (told under the second month of this year, when the Jin army went back north).

note: 「「應河南新復路分見任文武官，各安職守，並不易置；山寨土豪等，優與推恩；應陝西掌兵官，昨緣撫馭失宜，致有離散，非其本心，今來既已歸還，各仰安職；應進士諸科」（續資治通鑑·卷121） 金以河南、陝西地歸宋（州目據金志南京路及陝西五路）
noteEn: "The civil and military officials now in post in the newly recovered circuits of Henan are each to stay at their duties and will not be replaced; the leaders of the hill forts and the local strongmen are to be generously rewarded; the officers commanding troops in Shaanxi, who were scattered through mismanagement and not by their own wish, now that they have returned are each to stay at their posts." Jin returns Henan and Shaanxi to Song (the prefectures are those of the Southern Capital circuit and the five Shaanxi circuits in the Jin treatise).

note: 「是春，夏人乘折可求之喪，陷府州」（續資治通鑑·卷121）
noteEn: "In this spring the men of Xia, using the death of She Keqiu, took Fuzhou."

note: 「五月，丙子，金主詔元帥府復取河南、陝西地」（續資治通鑑·卷123）
noteEn: "In the fifth month, on the day bingzi, the ruler of Jin ordered the marshal's office to take back the land of Henan and Shaanxi."
